reviews.text:
We live in the East Valley (Chandler/Tempe) and it's always a treat to go to some local favorites. From the moment you arrive at The Phoenician, you walk into an idyllic setting. We tried Mowry & Cotton the other night to celebrate our anniversary and spend time with my mom, sister, and son.

We were immediately greeted by the staff and sat in a comfortable and elegant setting. Our server, Dora, was knowledgeable about the wine and pairings. Her dining assistant, Iris, was prompt, never let our waters deplete, and made sure the table was taken care of. Dora specifically recommended a delicious white, a rosé, and delicious reds to complement our appetizers and dinner. 

The food was spot on! The branzino delectable! Red snapper, was fresh, highly recommend! My son's streak perfectly cooked! Yum! 

But for real it was the Service of see Dora!
reviews.author: Tracy S.

reviews.text: Located inside the Phoenician hotel this is a great spot for breakfast lunch or even dinner. You can choose from a buffet breakfast or order off of the menu. We ordered off of the menu we waited about 20 minutes for a table outside our server was great and very helpful. I recommend the avocado toast. It was delicious.
reviews.author: Patricia Z.

reviews.text: Great breakfast spot on campus. We came back here daily, especially if you are a hotel member and can get discounts on the breakfast. It really made sense to bring the whole family here and it was nice to be able to switch up the order every day for something new. Also kids under three eat for free so my son had the opportunity to grab the buffet which was clutch, especially for a picky eater. Staff was super friendly and helpful and the views are beautiful and right next to the pool.
reviews.author: Sean S.

reviews.text: great time! they were able to accommodate our large group on a friday night. super friendly staff, ryland got us seated and dora took care of us. everything was great. shishito peppers in particular. we had burrata dip which was also great. mushroom flatbread would have been better if it had been hot. meatballs were also a hit. the steaks were all cooked to perfection, branzino was great, green beans (don't remember what kind of bean, but they were green, were amazing! yukon potatoes were too thin but tasted good. other potatoes and brussel sprouts were delish! would love to come back!
reviews.author: Carrie S.

reviews.text: I really like the ambiance here. Western but modern. Weather was perfect for dinner outside. I got the hanger steak and it was cooked perfectly. All the sides we shared were fantastic as well. Our server, Hector, was delightful and made the evening even more fun.
reviews.author: Shauna C.

reviews.text: 5 stars for the service, 3 stars for the logistics. Our server was amazing and made my friend's birthday celebration so special! That said, trying to make a reservation was incredibly frustrating. After several calls and a voicemail with no response, I had to call the concierge the day of just to get someone on the line. I love this place, but I hope they improve their phone/booking system so it matches the excellent service they provide in person
reviews.author: Kanu J.

reviews.text: Enjoy a great dining experience in the beautiful Phoeniician Resort.  Delicious food with great surroundings.  Looking forward to our next dining experience/happy hour.Ed C.
reviews.author: Ed C.

reviews.text:
Beautiful setting in a luxury Resort. We had a nice table outside on the patio. Four of us met for lunch and hadn't seen each other in years. 
The food was good. The Brunch menu was decent. Our Server interrupted us constantly. It was so annoying! She couldn't just swing by and look to see and make herself available if we needed anything. We had to stop the conversation to answer her over and over. It left a sour taste in what should have been a wonderful meal with old friends.
reviews.author: Laurie P.

reviews.text:
You can't go wrong here!!!
Breakfast is amazing, service as well both top shelf! If you are at the Phoenician you have to check this place out!
reviews.author: Rick D.

reviews.text:
We chose Mowry & Cotton at The Phoenician in Scottsdale for our New Year's Eve celebration, expecting a special, well-executed experience worthy of the venue and the price. Unfortunately, it was a major disappointment.

At $120 per person, we anticipated attentive service, a festive atmosphere, and food served properly. Instead, our meal arrived very late and cold, which immediately took away from the experience. Even more surprising was the complete lack of any New Year's celebration elements -- no champagne toast, no countdown, no party favors such as blowers, crowns, or leis. There was nothing that made the evening feel like New Year's Eve.

For a restaurant associated with The Phoenician, the overall execution fell far below expectations. This was not the quality, service, or celebration we expected for a premium holiday event, and sadly, it did not feel worth the cost.
reviews.author: Virginia Y.

reviews.text: I didn't get to take pictures of the food, but everything was delicious and freshly made. We ordered the lamb ragu pasta and the skirt steak with a side of mushroom soup. My pasta was freshly cooked and the lamb ragu was delicious. The staff was welcoming to my kids and that's always a plus. Kids eat free! They got the salmon with broccoli and rice and the burger and fries. Somehow they still put it on the tab, but i pointed out to the server and he gladly took it off. The setting is beautiful at sunset. We also go to walk on the Christmas garden that was beautifully lit. Don't forget to get your parking ticket comped! Will come back for sure :)
reviews.author: Renata L.

reviews.text: I ate here multiple times during my stay at the Phoenician. The food (breakfast and lunch) was consistently good, and the ambiance was very nice as well. My favorites were the tuna bowl and porcini soup
reviews.author: Sunil R.

reviews.text: Horrible... The bartender actually told us that we need to be patient because she had too many tables this is supposed to be a five star hotel it sucked. We didn't even have brunch there.!
reviews.author: Megan M.

reviews.text: I would not recommend but others may love it!! It was not my kind of food. Everything had 5 or 6 toppings or add ons that made it a no for me. Our server was amazing. The restaurant was nicely decorated and has a beautiful view but if I am going to spend that much money then I want something better.
reviews.author: Angie H.

reviews.text:
Food was outstanding.  We ordered the burrata appetizer and it was delicious.  The bread that was served along with it was crisp.  My entree was also fabulous!  Lobster gnocchi was topped with a generous portion of lobster meat.  My.husband got the rib eye and said it was cooked to perfection.  
Our waiter was friendly and attentive.  
We will definitely be back
reviews.author: Chrissy L.

reviews.text:
Mowry and Cotton is located inside the Phoenician. We were staying here for the long Labor Day weekend so I decided to check it out for dinner on Thursday. The staff was very friendly and chose to sit outside on the patio which overlooks the pool area and hotel grounds. They have misters around the patio which keeps the heat down but they did drip water on me. I didn't mind but something to be aware of if you're wearing a fancy outfit and don't want water drops on it. 

My server was friendly but I found the speed or the service very slow and often I was looking around for her to order. The drinks took forever to arrive I had finished my entire meal and she never checked on me once and I still didn't received my drink order. I would have given the place four stars if the service was better. 

The branzino was fantastic, probably one of the better ones I've had. The char and crispy skin was incredible and it was seasoned perfectly. I also enjoyed the buttermilk buns. I didn't love the butter or pickled vegetables. The flavors didn't work for me. But I appreciate the unique spin and complexity of the offering. I think I would have preferred just basic butter as an option, instead it was just two specialty ones. The buns were good enough on their own though without any butter. 

The cocktails were also refreshing. I would go again but maybe sit in the bar to get better service.
reviews.author: Laura E.

reviews.text: This restaurant is 10/10! WOW! Service is top notch, Christian L. Is amazing. The lobster gnocchi and salmon is chefs kiss and don't even get me started on the mushroom flat bread, holy moly. They do limit you on the portions though, they're strict on the portion control but nonetheless I'm leaving beyond satisfied. Oh don't forget to get the banana nut bread pudding
reviews.author: bailey j.

reviews.text: Great service. Amazing food! We had Raul as our server tonight and he exceeded our expectations. He is truly a mixologist behind the bar as well!
reviews.author: Reagan W.

reviews.text:
Beautiful French toast with lemon curd and blueberries. 

A large looking portion but light and fluffy centre 

10/10 and a must try!
reviews.author: Katie H.

reviews.text: I went in March during Spring Training in March. This is located in The Phoenician. I went for breakfast. The place is nice and located at the bottom level of the property by the pools. They were busy but still had tables available. Our food took a long time to come. I think they were short staffed. One guy in our group got hangry; meanwhile, I was just enjoying my latte and relaxing. The presentation of my Avocado Benedict was nice and it was good. The bread part could've been a little more soft but good otherwise. My latte was good as well. As with any resort, I thought the food was a little overpriced but great if you want a nice breakfast out with friends.
reviews.author: Patsy L.

reviews.text: This was our first visit and we will definitely be back! I took my wife here for brunch and Ernesto our server was amazing. He explain the menu and helped us pick the perfect meal. We will definitely be back, thanks Ernesto for making brunch even more special.
reviews.author: Tim B.

reviews.text: From the moment we walked in we were greeted by the hostess, Hope. She was kind, attentive & smiley. She answered our questions regarding the atmosphere & was super helpful. Ernesto our server was super helpful in explaining the menu & giving us his recommendations on his favorites from the Brunch menu. It was our first time in & we will definitely be back. As we were leaving Hope took the time to ask about our experience & showed us the food menus & encouraged us to come back to try the dinner menu. Thanks Hope & Ernesto for a great Brunch experience!
reviews.author: Stefanie D.

reviews.text:
Loved this for breakfast 
Great service.  Chris was great 
The eggs Benedict was very good 
The place is very stylish and kept up
reviews.author: Justin B.

reviews.text:
We came here looking for dinner during our first night at the Phoenician. 

We were able to get quick reservations and Hector was our server. 

The location and view is lovely, very relaxing vibe. 

We wee seated right when it opened and they were out of scallops, which we had ordered. 

I moved on to order a filet, it was very tender but a little dry. The mashed potatoes were absolutely wonderful. 

The salmon was good, crispy potatoes good. Kids chicken breast was dry and we ordered fries as the side for the kids meal and was charged 7.00 for the side!

Once our dinner was served we didn't see our waiter for a long time, our drinks ran dry and I had to ask twice for hector to bring the bill.

*if you are looking for an AMAZING meal at the Phoenician look into the Tavern!
reviews.author: Brittney C.

reviews.text:
This was our first and only meal here while staying @ The Phoennecian. It was the only breakfast option on the property. We were not disappointed. 

I didn't want a gut buster breakfast so I opted for the Egg White Frittata and I skipped the pesto which I like but I didn't need the extra calories. The goat cheese and veggies added plenty of flavor. It was served piping hot too. The ONLY way to eat eggs am I right? 

My husband ordered the French Toast. It was made of 2 huge thick pieces of bread topped with blueberries and a lemon sauce I think. It really didn't need any butter or syrup TBH but he wanted all the flavors lol. 

Our server was very friendly and attentive. He made just the right amount of small talk. Not yo chatty but showed genuine interest. We would definitely come here again.
reviews.author: Melissa D.

reviews.text: We dined here for breakfast 3 days in a row. Good service but maybe, could be warmer or friendlier, especially for breakfast. Inconsistent application of employee discount with Titanium Elite benefit. The way they do the billing/breakdown is confusing. Food taste is okay. Presentation is overly plain and basic. If you order omelette, it is really just omelette on the plate, no other sides. If you want carb/starch, it will have to be ordered separately, which really adds up.
reviews.author: B S.

reviews.text: Service was kind and on point with everything however quality of food did not match price point. Food was still tasty.
reviews.author: Gen C.

reviews.text: This is an awesome restaurant with a beautiful pool view at the Phoenician! The location makes it a very relaxing spot. The service was great and the food was very delicious and well-made.
reviews.author: Madeline C.

reviews.text: First time at Mowry and Cotton at the Phoenician. I have to say trying to find parking was a little challenging but the valet guys were able to direct me. Valet parking at the Phoenician is 28 dollars in cash, but the parking garage is 12 dollars for 4 hours. It is a little challenging getting to the actual restaurant because you have to take two different elevators but the front desk or any worker is more than happy to direct you. Moving on the  best part my experience, the food. Sunday brunch is the best way to spend your Sunday and my dinning experience was lovely. I ordered the caramel latte with oatmilk, I love how it came with a little harden stick of sugar to sweeten your drink to your liking. The lonely monkey bread was really good, it was warm filled with nuts, fruit jams and cream. For my main dish I got the smoked brisket Benedict. I was informed the brisket is smoked in house. It was absolutely delish, well seasoned and tender. I will definitely recommend the smoked brisket Benedict. I have to say the service was really good. Our waitress was attentive throughout our entire dinning experience and gave us good recommendations. I'll definitely be back.
reviews.author: Maria A.

reviews.text:
We stayed at The Phoenician and had breakfast here every day. On warmer mornings we ate outside and it was really nice. There were a few cooler days that we did eat indoors.
We had Rachael as our server the first day and really liked her fun personality. We asked to sit in her section everyday and were able to! She provided us with great service and menu suggestions. 
Rachael was not working our last two days. Unfortunately, the service wasn't very good those two days.
We had breakfast there seven days and I don't think we had the same thing twice. I'm not a huge breakfast person and the portions are a nice size, so my husband and I ended up splitting an entree each day. I took photos of a few of our meals and forgot to the rest of the time we were there.
I'd recommend Mowry and Cotton!
reviews.author: Melanie B.

reviews.text: Went here again.... 3 years later, nothing but great service and great food! Had brunch menu and was a party of 10, we didn't have 1 complaint!
reviews.author: Amanda K.

reviews.text:
I recently stayed at the Phoenician and decided to try Mowry and Cotton for brunch. The resort is beautiful and the ambiance in the restaurant gives off a very cool vibe. I sat on the patio and had a great view of the pool. My experience was so good I came back the next day for lunch. 

Let's dig in. The staff was extremely friendly, attentive, and honest about what they liked on the menu. I love that. For brunch I had the croque madam which was a fantastic version. It's served on thick brioche bun and was seasoned perfectly. The rosemary ham was a nice touch. A few glasses of rose paired well with the meal and the chill ambiance and view of the pool left me relaxed. 

For lunch I had the Mowry Burger and fries. Again, everything was cooked and seasoned perfectly. The burger was exactly medium rare, the fries were crispy, and the shallot jam on the burger elevated the flavor. 

Not sure why this place only had 3.5 stars. Excellent food (twice), a beautiful and relaxing feel, and a friendly, professional, staff. It's an easy return for me next time I'm in town.
reviews.author: Armen A.

reviews.text: We have been going to Mowry & Cotton for many years. It's our go to place for special occasions. It was our first date and our anniversary place for years. We enjoy the ambience and the service. We are always greeted and made to feel welcome. When it comes to the food, the taste and texture is amazing. The food is delicious and an art form. You can tell how much thought and effort is given by the chef. It's is truly a wonderful dining experience every time. The drinks are also thoughtfully paired with your meal to make it even a better experience. Enjoy!
reviews.author: Doc H.

reviews.text:
This place has a super cool atmosphere, but so far every time we have gone it's been pretty empty and I'm not sure why. The service has been good and friendly. 

The food is good. I enjoyed my salmon both times I ordered it. They have a kids menu which is nice. They have a unique selections of flatbreads and you can watch them get made which is kind of fun. 

I probably wouldn't go out of my way to eat here, but it's a nice restaurant in the hotel.
reviews.author: Emma T.

reviews.text:
Beautiful venue with a very relaxed vibe. The bar area has a Speakeasy feel and an outstanding cocktail selection. Bourbon drinkers will rejoice in a long list of top shelf whiskey to choose from. 
Menu is small, but solid. Flatbreads are excellent and the Chopped Salad is fresh and perfectly dressed. Hangar steak was good, not great. The side of roasted potatoes however were outstanding. 
What stood out most to me was the service. Bartenders and table waitstaff are knowledgeable,  attentive and very pleasant.
reviews.author: John C.

reviews.text: Excellent breakfast.  I sat down for a fast breakfast. I had a latte and a delicious yogurt with interesting fruits and nuts and quinoa. The setting is spectacular, on a patio overlooking palm trees and a swimming pool. Service was really good.
reviews.author: Charles L.

reviews.text:
It was wonderful inside and outside dining for breakfast. We sat outside, which, for us NY'ers, felt warm. A handful of people were also eating outside with heaters available. It was a pretty view of the pool and all. 
The coffee, eggs, toast, bacon, potatoes, etc., were all delicious. The staff was nice and friendly. We will be back again.
reviews.author: Jill R.

reviews.text: Loved this spot in The Phoenician hotel. There were great vegetarian options including the beet and burrata salad (whipped ricotta, yum!), squash soup, and acorn squash flatbread. Friend had the hanger steak and loved it! Good service and charming environment.
reviews.author: Courtney B.

reviews.text: Service was very good but food was underwhelming. Convenient location if staying at resort. Place was empty.
reviews.author: Tim M.

reviews.text:
We booked a dinner at Mowry and Cotton after spending a day by the pool for our guest of honors birthday. The cabana people must have told them or made a note that we were celebrating as the waitress acknowledged the birthday and offered us a free drink to upon sitting down to celebrate. The waitress was quick and attentive the entire service. 

We got to sit out on the patio night and it was wonderful. We could overlook the empty lot up pool and the mountains in the back. 

For a starter we got the buttermilk buns. They came out on a charcuterie style board with the buns and couple different spread options. We especially loved the jam. We also got the veal meatballs and they were wonderful. Then we ordered Brussels sprouts for the table and they were delicious! We complimented them and the waitress told us they were one of the chefs specialties! The mashed potatoes were also amazing. The entrees were equally as amazing as the rest of the food. 

Afterwords we went up to the patio upstairs to finish the night with some drinks and dessert. We would definitely come back.
reviews.author: Jenae W.

reviews.text:
Update to my older review. 
We recently did a staycation and got the breakfast option again. It was still great! I got the pancakes one day and French toast the next. Hot tip: kids under 3 eat free! Which is great because my two year old is VERY particular about her food so I always feel bad to waste money on a meal she doesn't touch. She loved the waffles. The tiny syrup that they give you with each breakfast is so cute too! I had a latte, which was great and some fresh squeezed oj! The service was quick and every server that we had was knowledgeable and helpful. I can't remember exactly what my husband has but it was the savory dishes and he was very happy.
reviews.author: Kirsten Z.

reviews.text: I will start with the food which was very good! I ate there 3 times while on the resort and each time it was delicious. Even the simple meals were gourmet!!! I highly recommend the smoked salmon, the turkey sandwich , steak & eggs and the BLT. Lovely place with lovely staff. I will definitely return!!!
reviews.author: Joy S.

reviews.text:
If we could give more stars we would.  We notified the restaurant ahead of time that we'd prefer outdoor seating and were celebrating our anniversary, and, the entire experience did not disappoint.  

They provided complimentary champagne at the start of the meal with another round with our dessert at the end to cap things off perfectly.  They were professional, yet, engaging with us when tableside and seemed to cater to our every request with ease!  Even though our main waiter was also double duty manning the bar, he always was close by or sent over a fellow waiter to ask if we needed anything!  It was NCAA Tournament time too and his Cyclones were battling on TV, but he still made the rounds and made us feel comfortable.  

The seafood was amazing, but my ribeye was the absolute star of the evening.  I know there is a famous steakhouse situated in the resort, but do not overlook this piece of meat for your next dinner if in the Scottsdale area!   Thank you for a most memorable dining experience.
reviews.author: Jake M.

reviews.text:
Spectacular breakfast although from seating service attendants are fair 
the service of Jorge was great and the suggestion  for egg white frittata was the best and the fruit yogurt parfait was amazing
Coffee from Fante Seattle coffee was delicious
reviews.author: Andrew M.

reviews.text:
The Phoenician overall is a pretty amazing property and Mowry & Cotton certainly holds up to this standard. 

The service has only gotten better over the years, as well as the food. 

Whatever is going on at the property, I greatly approve!
reviews.author: James S.

reviews.text: Who doesn't love a good açaí breakfast bowl &  huevos ranchero's! We ate at the Phoenician resort where we stayed and it was a yummy last breakfast the food was delicious and because we stayed there it was free with our $50 discount! It was a win win! And the service was so sweet and the ambiance beautiful and overlooking the pools on a gorgeous summer day! The inside is also really nice and fancy
reviews.author: Iris P.

reviews.text: We were happy with the ambiance and the appetizers. Our server, Dora, was very nice as well. That's where it ends. My husband's steak was over done so they made him a new one which had us eating our anniversary dinner separately! So bizarre and wrong! They also sat a crying toddler right next to us-he was not able to be soothed and that was a complete bummer as well. Placement of people with crying littles especially when they came in crying really needs to be addressed. There were plenty of other tables not right on top of us. Definitely a one and done restaurant.
reviews.author: Janet B.

reviews.text: Awoke this morning at the world renown Phoenician Resort and let me tell you there is no doubt this Oasis lives up to its excellent reputation. And the food here is only eclipsed by the service, and ambiance they create. Yes the view and resort are beautiful but let's talk about Pancakes! Wow the buttermilk banana pancakes are simply delicious! Fluffy, filling and flavorful. Of course I had coffee, which I am a coffee snob and this coffee was blended beautifully and the cup size was perfect to enjoy slowly. Also because coconut oatmeal intrigued me I had a small cup and I have found a new favorite! All in all a fantastic morning breakfast and Angelica my server made me feel like I was talking to family while visiting their home. I'll be back in the morning for breakfast again! LOL
reviews.author: Mark G.

reviews.text:
Food: the food was delicious! There were 3 of us and what ended up doing was ordering a few dishes and passing it around to share and there was still plenty left afterwards! My favorite was their fajita and the salad! I don't know what they put in their Caesar salad but it was just too good! 

Service: the service was wonderful! Our server was very knowledgeable and had great recommendations! 

Ambiance: I cannot even explain the scenery while we ate. The restaurant is literally in the backyard of the resort so we had the beautiful sky, the sun, the pool, laughter of the kids in the background while we ate! Such a perfect lunch date!
reviews.author: Edenielle A.

reviews.text:
Place is quite nice, it is the part of Phoenician so it got some class. All the waitresses/waiters got the proper manner to serve food and provide services promptly. 

Food is a little better than average. It is not like "food is so good that I want to come back". But slight above average food with nice ambiance made me want to come back again. 

Dinner maybe pricey but I didn't think the place was expensive for the brunch, considering all the factors above.
reviews.author: Jesse K.

reviews.text: Host and waitress kept us waiting for a very long time despite our table being ready, and weekend brunch buffet ends at 11, so we missed it. Poorly managed for a Marriott
reviews.author: JD W.

reviews.text:
We ate here everyday during our stay at the Phoenician either for breakfast, lunch or dinner. The staff here is wonderful and the service was great. I loved seeing the diversity of the staff as well.

I thought the food here was very good so I was surprised to see some of the bad reviews.

For breakfast, we did get complimentary breakfast as part of the Marriott program which was the continental breakfast that consisted of a croissant, fruit with yogurt and coffee or juice. I loved how they were accommodating and allowed us to swap out the croissant for bread and getting oatmeal instead of the yogurt. One of the days we opted to get the breakfast buffet and just paid the difference and it was a very good buffet. There was a variety of food to choose from: omelet station, smoked salmon, charcuterie meat selections, different types of pastries, bacon, sausage, oatmeal, fruit, berry smoothie and green juice, roasted vegetables, cereals.

They have a nice indoor and outdoor seating as well in addition to the bar area.
reviews.author: Quan D.

reviews.text: Great food and service. We came for a quick work lunch and the servers were friendly and accommodating. I ordered the sausage flatbread, which was delicious and savory! It's a beautiful restaurant inside, and if you come at the right time, you may also get to meet Harris' Hawk!
reviews.author: Sasha P.

reviews.text: We took the cocktail class with Lexi and it was SO MUCH FUN.  She taught us so many things about mixology and it was one of the highlights of the trip.  Highly, highly recommend doing this- and definitely see Lexi at the bar in general- she had great suggestions and was clearly very passionate about what she does.
reviews.author: Jackie N.

reviews.text: We just ate breakfast here, but what a great way to start our day. Everything was nothing short of amazing. Awesome  service great food! Had the best service from our server. It was a great experience! The service was top tier and will be referring friends and returning with family.
reviews.author: Josie J.

reviews.text:
I'm a bit disappointed. I'm a local and somehow have just now managed to try out the place after being told their brunch is really something. 

So let's start with food; not terrible, nothing to be remembered, either. Candied bacon was chewy and hard. Pork was cooked fine. Shakshuka was a bit dry. Chicken sausage was good. Fries were blah. Coffee was really bitter. 

Ambiance - feels like you're at a resort. Pretty and relaxing but it wasn't packed for brunch and I was a bit surprised by that. 

Service - not okay. Our waitress was so cold! It seriously affected everyone at the table. No warmth or kindness. I felt scared to ask her for a mimosa after she came with the first two mimosa orders for others at the table. Just annoying. Really threw off the vibe. Also, I had mentioned it was my mothers birthday and I'm bummed there was nothing brought to her as a gesture (it didn't have to be anything bug!) and it was clear no one read the notes because our table had way too much extra seating as well and again, pissy waitress has an attitude as she removed the extra plates and silverware. Ugh, just obnoxious. 

Not going back here
reviews.author: Renee Y.

reviews.text:
This breakfast BLT was soooooo good! The brioche bun was perfectly soft and fluffy. Flavor was great with all the sauces, bacons, and egg. Side of potatoes were nice and crispy. 

Friend got the cappuccino and it came with a cookie and rock candy! Super cute and she loved it so much she got a second!
reviews.author: Mary Z.

reviews.text: Visited for restaurant week. Also had the buttermilk buns which were amazing . I recommend you order the Local Citrus for starters. Delicious fresh fruit sourced locally .Awesome  service great food.
reviews.author: Mary P.

reviews.text:
I have to up my review cuz I REALLY like the new chef here.  The food and drinks are always good and solid.  The staff is usually in point, but I do recall one not very pleasant experience with someone here that I won't name cuz don't want to get them in trouble, where me and my friend were shocked cuz we have had this person before and never had bad service from this person before so that was why it was shocking.  We were seated separately and both felt this and then sat together so it was really weird.  We're gonna assume something was going on their personal life affecting so didn't say anything.  Anyways...

I usually stop by here when I'm doing a spa day, just to change up the food.  The drinks are always yummy and the food is usually always good.  The last time I was here, it was my first time coming for dinner and I really enjoyed the food, my server (I think his name was Eric?), and I met the new manager, Matt.  Everything was great other than a very minor delay in getting the milk bread that I ordered after my entree came out.  But seriously good food, wine and service.  Been telling my friends cuz they also didn't like the last chef to give it a try.  Oh, also learned the current chef is also female so props!:). And also just learned I can't post all my food pix lol--sorry!  Know that it's noms:)
reviews.author: Christina B.

reviews.text: If one is going to sit outside, you can forget about being served and service can be extremely frustrating, had to go and pick up salt and pepper, pen to sign bill etc. on our own. The sorbet is extremely sour and not a tasty desert. Silverware and glasses had stains on them and not 5 star quality. Food taste is also very average.
reviews.author: Jessica P.

reviews.text:
Attention. Vegans... The huevos rancheros was amazing. 
Way overpriced since they did remove chicken and still charged extra for vegan "sausage" but was very tasty.
Few other Brahman options was nice.
reviews.author: Dustin C.

reviews.text:
Food was ok. 

I was sort of baffled to see an 18% service charge on my tab with two people at the table. I understand doing that for large parties as I've worked in the high end restaurant industry in the past, but on a two person tab and then to expect a further tip ON TOP of that?

That's insulting. I'm not tipping you twice and I would have tipped more than your 18% service charge, so you're ultimately missing out.
reviews.author: Mike S.

reviews.text: Had breakfast daily at this restaurant at the beautiful Phoenician resort. The ambience was great with the patio overlooking the palm tree lined swimming pool.  The service was top notch and impressive!. My server, Jorge was prompt, friendly and thoughtful. When I mentioned the dry heat was getting to me and I needed electrolytes, Jorge went out of his way to go get a Gatorade for me! I don't remember seeing this as an option on the menu and I think he went to another area of the hotel to get it. This really WOW'd me as you don't get this kind of exceptional service much these days. I had lots of different items from the breakfast menu during the week I was there and I'll include photos. It was all delicious but the simple salad that came with the brisket Benedict was my favorite! So good! Highly recommend this spot!
reviews.author: Valerie W.

reviews.text: I came to Mowry & Cotton for their Arizona Restaurant Week special. It's within the Phoenician so parking is rough. There is free self-parking lot but it is a bit of a hike to the restaurant. To get to Mowry & Cotton turn right in the lobby, walk down a flight of stairs, there is also an elevator. I ordered the steak which I loved. It was medium as requested and the mushrooms that came with it were amazing. My sister and dad ordered the same dish and requested medium as well but that's not what either of them received. One was very well done and the other was medium rare; for a high end restaurant with expensive prices this was very disappointing.  Loved the rustic Americana ambience and the food presentation was lovely, however the execution of my family's meals was subpar.
reviews.author: Alexis B.

reviews.text:
Phoenix has such an amazing brunch scene that you really expect a lot when you come to The Phoenician. The food was okay, but I was really underwhelmed by the service.

I ordered an egg white farmers frittata, which was excellent. To drink, I had a Green Nectar juice, which was underwhelming because it tasted pretty bland (it needs citrus or ginger to really make the flavor pop). 

We sat out on the patio, which has a lovely view of the back of the resort. There is a "hawk guy" who walks around with a large bird to educate the guests about. 

My issue with the service started when we checked in with the hostess. I sensed a little bit of a bad attitude when I said we were there for brunch and she mumbled under her breath that they were serving breakfast, not brunch (I didn't realize there was a difference!). The waitress seemed annoyed whenever we would ask her for something. 

I'm not a demanding customer, I just have a higher expectation for good service at the restaurant of a fancy resort. I would recommend going somewhere else for a good brunch in Phoenix but then come back to The Phoenician for drinks at the Thirsty Camel upstairs.
reviews.author: Kelly B.

reviews.text: Great service and cocktails.  The appetizers were great.  Unfortunately, the steaks were tough and a little overcooked.
reviews.author: Jim Bob B.

reviews.text:
I've been to Mowry & Cotton more than a handful of times since it opened... I've enjoyed breakfast once or twice and dinner at least five times.  It's always been good - some experiences better than others.  It is pricey, but remember, this restaurant is in a high end resort!

The staff is always super attentive and friendly.  On a recent visit with a large party of 9 (5 adults and 4 kids), Romeo was our waiter. He was personable and went above and beyond... especially with his interactions with the kids.

We often have friends and family visiting from out of town and staying at the Phoenician, so dining at Mowry & Cotton is an easy option during those times.  We'll continue to visit in the future and likely request Romeo as our waiter!
reviews.author: Gabi M.

reviews.text: Was visiting from Texas and had a quick lunch here before heading to the airport. Had a flatbread and a brisket sandwich; brisket was a little dry. Outdoor seating also has a beautiful view.
reviews.author: Lucero V.

reviews.text:
Ordered shrimp & grits...shrimp was overcooked(rubbery)
My husband ordered steak and eggs over medium...yolks were hard(not cooked over medium)
Staff was great.
reviews.author: Blue Water I.

reviews.text: A beautiful, glitzy place on a golf course with great views and is the hotel restaurant in a very high end Scottsdale Hotel. It's expensive for AZ, more like Bay Area prices. The service was attentive. My only concern was the not so special food. My scallops were underdone and rubbery. Virtually nothing came with them. No rice, potatoes or any other less expensive side.
reviews.author: Michael H.

reviews.text: Great french toast, as well as bagel with smoked salmon. Scrambled eggs were ok, but tasted like any other diner had made them. For the price we paid for breakfast, we wish we would've received slightly larger portions. Great atmosphere and interior design. Incredibly kind staff. Would definitely return, and would love to try lunch or dinner.
reviews.author: Jack S.

reviews.text: Food isn't really worth the price. The team is a little awkward and makes you feel uncomfortable. Very nice location though, nice scenery surrounding the restaurant.
reviews.author: Donovan M.

reviews.text:
New to Scottsdale for a year now and the number of places to eat is staggering.  Mowry and Cotton remains to be one of our top 5.   Breakfast favorites will be the yogurt, oatmeal or breakfast sandwich.    We always share a  Caesar salad and then have either the salmon or the flatbreads.  Everything is beautifully prepared. The setting near the pool is fabulous.  Comfortable chairs.  
*** I want to add, service is just as important to us and the main reason we come back to Mowry so often.  We love Angelica in the mornings.  For dinners it's both Hector and Christian.   We can bring friends or relatives and know we'll be treated very well.
reviews.author: Kenny S.

reviews.text: Awesome Breakfast. What else can I say? Hmm the breakfast sandwich was on point. The coffee was perfect, The waitress was quick, professional and welcoming. The view was fantastic. what a great way to start the day.
reviews.author: Manny G.

reviews.text: We visited the Phoenician for a friends birthday. It felt like we went on a mini vacation. We started with the buttermilk buns which were so good and gluten free. Next we split the scallops and hanger steak. Great presentation and yummy food for a special occasion.
reviews.author: Ms. Erin Rachel W.

reviews.text: What a fun hidden gem I believe mostly tourists try or Phoenician guests- a great spot for locals too! We booked dinner for a friends birthday. We probably didn't need a reservation there was a ton of open seating. We sat outside- tons of heaters and fire pits to keep us warm. Started with the buns and delicious burrata. So good! Entrees: I had the hanger steak- it was sweet and the mushrooms were amazing. My friend had the filet- melt in your mouth, and my other friend had the scallops- very good and huge. We shared the potatoes and persimmon salad as well with plenty left over. We waited quite a bit for water refills and it was strange they kept asking to clear the apps off our table (every few minutes). Would definitely come here again!
reviews.author: Katie M.

reviews.text: Well, I wanted this place to be awesome but it fell short. The drinks, a martini up and a hablano  margarita were very good. We each had a salad, one avacado Caesar and one mixed green. Both very fresh and tasty.  So far, so good. For entrees we ordered the Thai snapper and filet to share. Sides were crispy potatoes and brussels. Potatoes were excellent and the Brussels a little underdone. The mains were disappointing. The snapper was dry and the filet came out medium instead of medium rare. Jordan, our server, was apologetic and scooped the steak up to re-fire. Unfortunately the corrected steak came out much after we were done with the meal. In hindsight, I should have cancelled it.  Version two of the steak was cooked perfectly but it was to late by then. The potential is surely there for this place but the execution was off on this night.
reviews.author: Michael C.

reviews.text:
Beautiful way to start the day! Outdoor seating, temp was perfect! Wait staff was wonderful, quick and attentive.

I enjoyed the egg whites and chicken sausage. Egg were cooked and seasoned perfectly. My husband says who can mess up egg whites, but trust me, people have! I'm also not much of a tater tot person, but these were crispy and delicious.

Husband enjoyed his ham and cheese omelet. Said the ham was very good. Also had a side of rye.

Great breakfast stop in a hotel!
reviews.author: Danielle J.

reviews.text: They eggs Benedict was delicious! The portions are good and shareable. We also had lunch here and the tacos were delicious. The food came out hot (even the side of tater tot's and fries) servers are very welcome and friendly. The falcon was such a cool part of the morning entertainment/education.
reviews.author: Natalie W.

reviews.text: This is because of the music. Couldn't be the worst music in a restaurant. So loud and awful, we couldn't hear ourselves think. And it wasn't even good music! Just awful. Couldn't enjoy anything because it was so distracting and they wouldn't do anything about it when asked.
reviews.author: G D.

reviews.text:
Very solid hotel restaurant that I would love to come back just for the for the food and vibe. 

It is on the pricey side for the main course, the salmon, in my mind, but drinks and side dishes were reasonably priced.
reviews.author: Alex G.

reviews.text: We dined at Mowry & Cotton while staying at the Phoenician Resort on a birthday staycation. We had a reservation the next evening at J&G Steakhouse so we decided to dine here the first evening we arrived. Upon arrival, the hostesses were so kind to us. They were so accommodating to my one year-old son. He was waving at them and blowing them kisses. They actually went upstairs and said that they had something for him. They came back with an adorable bunny rabbit stuffed animal and said he could keep it. It was so sweet. It's the little things like that that really make me want to come back to an establishment. Kept him busy for all of two minutes and then we had to move on. Toddler life. They gave him a high chair and soon our server had greeted us. Our server was great. He was a student at ASU, really attentive and knew the menu very well. He was very honest about the menu items that we were exploring. We opted to get the peach flatbread to share for an appetizer. I got the avocado Caesar salad and added a piece of salmon, although that was not an option on the menu, they said it was my birthday and I could do whatever I wanted. I appreciated that. It was delicious, very heavy on the cheese, but that's expected when ordering a Caesar salad. My husband ordered the steak, which came highly recommended by our server. I was so excited to learn that they had my very favorite wine there. I can't find it anywhere, and it's difficult to order online. It's called illumination. If you like Sauvignon Blanc, I definitely recommend this. Unfortunately it was not sold by the glass, only by the bottle. My husband of course, told me to order it because it was my birthday. The server helped the sale by saying that I could cork it and bring it back to the room. We did just that and kept it cold and I had a glass each night we were there. It took a while to finish, but I certainly did. Hundred dollar bottle of wine was well worth it! The wine was sort of a highlight to be honest, my salad was good but a little too cheesy for me. My husband was very happy with his steak. We also ordered my son the grilled chicken off of the kid's menu. He was pleased with that, and his bunny rabbit. I have no idea how much everything cost, so I can't weigh in on the price but I would assume for a resort it might be on the high end. Still less than J&G Steakhouse though. My sister called in a birthday dessert for me as well as they gave me one on the house, so suddenly we had two desserts. My sister ordered the crème brûlée, and the dessert on the house ended up being three scoops of different flavored ice cream that they make in house. The ice cream was a little too much for me, but it was delicious. My husband loved the sorbet flavor. I liked the salted caramel. Overall, this dining experience was great. The next morning, we were looking to have breakfast, and I knew this was the restaurant where they had it. I was excited since we had already gone there and discovered what a nice place it was. I figured that because it was a resort they would have a buffet breakfast, but that wasn't the case. They did have a delicious and healthy menu for breakfast. I ordered an egg white bowl that was absolutely delicious and for a resort breakfast I didn't feel too full. My husband ordered the bagel and lox which I was so excited about because that would've been my second, naughty choice. I had a bite and that was delicious as well they had all the fixings. They also accommodated my son with a yogurt and granola bowl. There were a few strawberries and bananas on skewers. He loves bananas so I asked for a few more. They happily obliged. It was yummy as I took a bite. The whole breakfast experience was great. I love the environment. You could sit inside or outside for breakfast and dinner. We also had the most amazing server who has a son who is my age. We chatted a little bit about traveling with a baby. I highly recommend this restaurant. I enjoyed both dining experiences.
reviews.author: Addy G.

reviews.text: Dined at Mowry & Cotton yesterday and had an absolutely delicious breakfast. Best part about it was the top notch service from Christine. She was amazing. We were celebrating our daughter's birthday and Christine made it extra special. Got the egg white frittata which was full of veggies and the pistachio pesto was super good. We loved it so much that we have decided to go back again today and sit with Christine again.
reviews.author: Michael S.

reviews.text: Christine is the absolute best server hands down. Attentive, fast to help and extremely friendly. It's hard to find a diamond in the rough like her. We dine here 5-6 times a year when vacationing and always ask for her.
reviews.author: Nadia S.

reviews.text:
Stayed at the Phoenician with my family and we came here for both dinner and breakfast the next day. Food was pricey, but well worth it. The corn soup was a big portion for an appetizer. The game hen was an interesting choice - kinda like a cross between chicken and duck. 

My favorites were the vegetables at dinner (shocker! they were just seasoned so perfectly) and the breakfast blt. Also, during breakfast, some dude with a literal hawk was coming by the tables. Never seen that at a restaurant before, but I'm here for it.
reviews.author: Emily I.

reviews.text: Pleasant atmosphere and beautiful view of the pool. Complimentary valet on Sunday. We had a bridal shower luncheon and everyone had a lovely time.
reviews.author: Linn M.

reviews.text: This review is for breakfast.  The food is pricey, but good.  My wife has to eat gluten-free and the breakfast buffet had an entire gluten-free station, complete with muffins, bagels, and breads with a gluten-free toaster.  I settled for the much-more affordable ham and cheese omelette, which is awesome (I didn't eat the guacamole on top though).  Service is friendly and sitting outdoors is neat.
reviews.author: James M.

reviews.text:
We finally had dinner here. I definately have to say I enjoy brunch the most. I prefer their other restaurants on site for dinner. Service is always great. I have to admit a bit slow. I had to relax and remember it's vacation time and to take it easy. I am used to go go go! We are always treated well. 

I had a wine on my bucket list I had to try. A couple cool hipsters on Yelp really enjoy. The bar did not have it in stock. Alicia our bar tender that day didn't just say no. She said " I don't have it in stock here, but I will check around for you! Oh and she found some for us and it was brought down for us! This is just one of dozens of going above and beyond experiences we have had here. Do make reservations ahead for dining  in thr evening especially during busy seasons. They close between meals so call for current hours when reserving. When they are not serving food there is still someone always there to answer questions and set up a reservation for you. They are very accommodating when it comes to food sensitivities as well!
reviews.author: Jessica S.

reviews.text:
Very disappointed tonight
We had a group of 4.
All our main dishes came out way over cooked and dried out
Doesn't even compare to the other restaurants in the hotel
I would not recommend this place 
Overpriced for what you get in return
reviews.author: Ryan B.

reviews.text: The main dining restaurant of The Phoenician and it's amazing for breakfast, lunch and dinner! Cosy yet upscale and modern. Service has always been very friendly and attentive. This venue has nice views of the pool area. Dining available indoors or al fresco. Menu is contemporary American and offers something for everyone.
reviews.author: Kate T.

reviews.text:
I checked into the Phoenician, and by the time I got settled in my room, I went out to find something to eat. I found this restaurant after about five minutes of walking around. I went in and the receptionist said sorry, we closed at 9. I looked at my phone, it was 9:03pm. I said thank you, don't worry about it, she said, are you sure? I can make some arrangements, or you can use "in room dining" and we can serve you there",
I told her, I really appreciate her willingness to accommodate me although you have closed, I will take your suggestions and order from my room:-)
She took the time to demonstrate that she cared about me, she was technically not supposed to take on additional customers but she was willing to accommodate me, and gave me some options.
I felt cared for and served although I left hungry :-). Made me look forward to going tomorrow, during work hours:)
if anybody's interested in hearing more about this experience, or interested in discussing current events, general politics, philosophies, scriptures or tree work of any sort, please feel free to reach out to me at 661-426-9526 and check out ArborWorksinc.com
I think it's important that we be talking more.
reviews.author: Chriso L.

reviews.text: Amazing service and savory food! My boyfriend and I recently had dinner here. We had pleasant experience, from the service to the food. Hostess iris and dulce were kind and sat us at a table with a perfect view. Our server Michel went above & beyond!!! We ordered a simple yet savory flat bread as our appetizer, fresh and exploding with bold flavors. The steak and pasta were tasty and delicious. Definitely coming back!!!
reviews.author: Elizeth P.

reviews.text:
Staying at the Phoenician for the holidays and Mowry and Cotton unfortunately is basically the main restaurant for the hotel. Food is average but i'd say a little below average at that. We've been for breakfast and "lunch" (but really they stop serving lunch at 2pm and only serve like 5 menu items after that)... Ceasar salad was mediocre and tasted like kraft dressing, turkey cuban is not very flavorful, oatmeal was served cold, eggs were good but it's really bad if you mess up eggs.

THE WORST is that this is basically the only place open for breakfast other than a very overpriced marketplace grab and go place... so you're basically out of luck... we go to get breakfast for 4 and despite over half of the restaurant being empty it's a 30 minute wait! i get it - hard for staffing these days but this is a 5 star hotel and we can't even get breakfast when the restaurant is empty?!
reviews.author: Jen A.

reviews.text:
If you are looking for excellent service to match the high prices, this place is not it. From the host desk to the wait staff, Mowry & Cotton acted like Denny's at 5x the price. The host station was abandoned for 10 minutes by BOTH hosts before we saw anyone. When Tom and Maria returned they argued between themselves extensively before acknowledging any of the half dozen waiting guests.

Once seated, it took 20 minutes to get a cocktail and 35 minutes to get our appetizers once the waitress took our order.

The assistant station was next to our table and had three bussers standing and chatting. Our water glasses went empty repeatedly without any attempt to fill them. Each time we had to interrupt their personal conversation to get more water. When the waitress on rare occasion checked in she left without having our water filled.

The managers at the Phoenician should be ashamed at their utter failure to provide basic service.

I won't be going back.
reviews.author: David A.

reviews.text: I wasn't impressed.  The staff were all focused on the mistakes they made with the last customer and really didn't rebound well. I had to get their attention to acknowledge me. The didn't ask where I wanted to sit even though the restaurant was almost empty which should have been my indication to run, but I wanted to try all of the spots at this phenomenal resort and wish I had skipped this one. The staff kept walking by us like we came in and didn't want to eat. I called one over and she redirected me to someone else. She took my order and when it arrived it was not cooked medium well it was medium.  I had to send it back. By the time I got my food my lunch companion was done eating. It was awkward.
reviews.author: Lorrice G.

reviews.text:
It was my husband's birthday and we decided to go to this restaurant at The Phoenician. 

The food was excellent but the service let us down. The delicious seafood main course arrived cold. There didn't seem to be a shortage of servers and yet we did not get the service one expects from a place like The Phoenician. No idea what happened. 

Even though we told the staff that it was my husband's birthday, they did t do anything special and delivered less than mediocre service.
reviews.author: Ulya K.

reviews.text: Great detailed touches of their branding throughout the experience. The decor and vibe is casual yet upscale. Attender who is in college for art was awesome - she did our comp beer tasting (included with resort fee). Our server has been with the hotel over 20 years (James?) and was awesome - he knew the menu and the hotel history like the back of his hand. Food was all awesome - expensive as resort dining is, but that's too be expected. The buttermilk buns were a great presentation and tasty.
reviews.author: Ashley C.

reviews.text:
Right in the middle. Good Breakfast/Brunch not amazing but good. The 1st day I had the Brisket Eggs Benedict, good but rather bland, for something with an "ancho chile hollandaise" there was absolutely no spice. I had to ask for hot sauce which made it great. 
TIP FOR BREAKFAST: The next time we had breakfast there we discovered that you can BUILD YOUR OWN OMELET. It's not on the menu but that was the best discovery ever. I highly suggest that.
One night during our stay we did go here for dinner and that was very tasty. I had the Hanger Steak and the asparagus my wife had the Buccatini Pasta. She loved her dish. My steak was cooked perfectly. The asparagus was nothing spee ial so I would say forget that side dish. What I won't ever forget though is the horrible stomach pain and urgent trip to the bathroom shortly after dinner. I dont know what brought it on but another colleague also had the hanger steak and also found himself sitting on porcelain shortly after. 
If I hadn't had resort credit to burn as part of trip I wouldn't have gone here and honestly I couldn't reccomend them for dinner because they ended my night.
reviews.author: Tony N.

reviews.text: Oh man, I really wanted to love this place. I will start with the ambiance and service...it was all great,  no complaints there. And of course the view of the pool and palm trees can't be beat. But the FOOD was meh. We had brunch and ordered the pancakes, chicken and waffle as well as the egg and bacon sandwich. The chicken was extremely hard and definitely tasted like it came from a bag of frozen chicken. The food was definitely not worth the price, I would love to try lunch or dinner so I can give it another chance.
reviews.author: Kristin T.

reviews.text:
The experience we had here could be described in two words. Just Okay. 

This was not a set the world on fire culinary experience. 

The service was okay. Slightly disappointing to be honest. Had to request waters and sodas to be refilled which seemed odd considering our table was directly next to the waiter stand. Had dirty  silverware.

The food was decent. 

The price points were a bit on the high side. 

We had the bread appetizer, a steak and a pasta dish. 

The bread appetizer was a bit strange. The bread came out a bit dense and cold which made it difficult to cut and share. And cold bread with butter and the other fancy things on the board just was not appealing to either of us. 

The steak was just that. A Steak. No sides. A small bit of garnish. In essence, it is a ribeye on a plate. 

The pasta was a bit more done up but the sauce was a bit bland and overall just not great. 

I think if you are staying at the hotel this could be a serviceable spot for lunch or dinner. But if you are a local Arizonan, this is a hard pass.
reviews.author: Fred K.

reviews.text:
Monica! Monica! Monica! If you have read my reviews in the past, you'll know my favorite thing to talk about is a phenomenal server! I recently took a very special friend of mine to celebrate her birthday lunch at Mowry & Cotton. We had a late reservation time (lunch closes at 2pm) and I was nervous about the type of service we would receive there. Monica was so wonderful, attentive, engaging, and as excited about this birthday celebration as we were. She made our experience the best we have had together! She gave wonderful recommendations (we both had the same Citrus Salmon and Chickpea bowl which was as gorgeous as it was tasty) and even brought us a candle on the Tahitian Vanilla Creme Brulee and a small to-go box for the cookies that went with it. We were there almost 2 hours and were never rushed or felt like we had to hurry and leave. We even had a chance to speak to the friendly manager to gush over what a wonderful job Monica was doing. And that day she was also working the bar as well as a certain number of tables. She was wonderful and I hope you will ask for her as well as have many reasons to gush to the manager about her too.

Sidenote: The brilliant Phoenician hires an aviary company that provides a Harris Hawk and trainer who roams the outdoor patio space. We asked and discovered this is a wonderful way to see an amazing predatory bird AND enjoy an outdoor lunch without the pesky birds that want to share your food with you. I think this is the most brilliant way to showcase our wonderful wildlife in Arizona AND safely keep pesky birds away. Bravo!
reviews.author: Catie B.

reviews.text:
Raul deserves special recognition. We arrived just after 2 PM from a day at the pool, and when we went inside one of the waiters said the lunch service was over. However, Raul approached us to see how we were doing , and when we said we were disappointed to have missed lunch he offered us a more menu, which was fine. (We had an attractively presented Cuban sandwich, and a thick burger that was done just my liking. The bacon was one of the meatiest, thickest, leanest cut I ever had: not on the menu but I asked to add it). Great red sangria. Crisp, thick fries.

Fresh, high quality ingredients overall, attractive decor and atmosphere, Clean restroom. (We are repeat guests of the resort.)

[Only wish I'd brought a more effective fly swatter than my book: I seriously recommend management equip staff with the responsibility to trap the flies or kill them off during the "off hours".]

The breakfast is awesome also. Pricey but enjoyable ambiance.
reviews.author: Edith H.

reviews.text: Went for lunch today. Had the crispy chicken sandwich and it was not good. The quality of chicken was not good. I recommend not getting the chicken sandwich. The breading was thick and soggy, not crispy at all. Someone else in my group had the Rueben and it was not good. The best part was the side salad that came with the sandwiches.
reviews.author: Ralph P.

reviews.text: Cool decor, terrible and unfriendly service, horrible menu (the head chef and/or manager need to be fired).  Had the weird burrata with quinoa and eggplant appetizer (weren't too many options) that had no flavor served with tortilla chips that were so salty you had to clean each chip before they were edible (I love salt) - toasted bread would have been a much better choice.  Server nor anyone else never smiled or looked us in the eye once.  Limited and unappetizing menu for a casual restaurant (at a very upscale resort).  My Sandwich (the Turkey Cuban) was just bad, presented bad and tasted bad, and not served on rye as described in the menu.  My wife and I were both starving and could barely eat our food, we left more than half of our meals and no one noticed.  The Service and everything else at the Phoenician is excellent, they are really falling short with this place.
reviews.author: Jason R.

reviews.text: We loved our server Ernesto! Great guy! Made our day! The food was great but service was better.
reviews.author: Moe W.

reviews.text:
While the restaurant decor and ambiance was beautiful, unfortunately our dining experience was not. 
The only food we actually finished was the buttermilk rolls and a flatbread appetizer. One of the meals came out with cheese, although they knew there was a dairy allergy. 
Mainly my disappointment fell in the service department, since the hostesses and our server knew we were there to celebrate our daughter's 13th birthday. However, our server never recognized her birthday at all. In fact when he brought our check, he said, "Ohh and I took her sorbet off for you." 
No "happy birthday" or anything. 
To pay over $200 for a birthday dinner and NOT to enjoy our experience was just really disappointing.
reviews.author: Candis C.

reviews.text:
Had a fabulous lunch here for work! We sat inside facing the window. The atmosphere was light, bright and noise level was moderate. 

Our appetizers were so good! The wild mushroom flatbread was sweet and savory as it had apricots and then the notes of the mushrooms and horseradish to balance it out. Oh course anything with truffles in it HAS to be amazing and boy was this dip! I will for sure be coming here again just for this dip! 

Next our entrees came in hot (literally)! The plates were so warm this our food stayed warm throughout the meal. I personally have the Salmon BLT and the fish was cooked perfectly and the bacon was crispy! 

My colleges also said that their food was packed full of flavor and cooked to perfection. 

Finally the best part of me was the signature Phoenician Ice Tea. I love Arnold Palmer's and with the sweet flavor of the prickly pear and really represents Arizona's flavor profile.
reviews.author: Cameo L.

reviews.text: We went twice there service was pretty good but we tried the food and it was absolutely awful. for lunch me and my father tried the chicken sandwich which we guessed were plain with coleslaw on the side but they had the coleslaw on the sandwich. Kind of odd we wondered why it tasted so different. For dinner I ordered the burger and it Was absolutely disgusting the fries are dry and lacking of salt (a grease wad) and no flavor, the burger tasted like shit and i ended up throwing up later. My father couldn't finish his filet mignon which had a special sauce that made it taste like crap. All in all this place felt like a kitchen nightmares episode considering the fact that our bill was 400 for that absolute crap. Don't eat here please. It's overpriced wannabe organic food
reviews.author: Alex H.

reviews.text: Consistently good resort dining option at the Phoenician. Sampled both breakfast and lunch fares here and an inventive menu with well executed veg dishes kept my family and I returning. The gorgeous outdoor seating didn't hurt either, though the person walking around with a trained hawk added a strange, dangerous flair to the ambiance.
reviews.author: Marc L.

reviews.text:
5 stars for amazing drinks and service

But 0 stars for sugar daddies

Very family friendly.

Lots of daddies no sugar zaddies
reviews.author: Sugar Z.

reviews.text: This is my second time here and I love how they switch the menu up seasonally. We celebrated my friends 40th birthday at the Phoenician and chose to eat here as the sun went down. They made the experience so wonderful!
reviews.author: Jamie S.

reviews.text:
This was a wonderful place to have dinner during sunset! The views are great outside overseeing the pool. They take reservations as well which I recommend doing if you have a big party.
They have a great menu too for brunch and dinner.
I loved their drink called The Sheriff. My to go to since it has tequila! Very good!
For food I got their Caesar salad with grilled chicken and it was fresh and tasty. They have a lot of other options too that are great to share with a group. Like flatbreads, Brussel sprouts, potatoes, etc. 
Overall they had great food, drinks, atmosphere, and service. Everyone who was helping our tables that night were wonderful and nice. This place was very pretty! I would definitely come back.
reviews.author: Victoria R.

reviews.text:
The worst possible service you can ever imagine 
The waiter was a nice guy the hostess was horrible would not move in umbrella for us to cover us from the sun rolled her eyes would not get a manager when we asked her for one and when the manager finally did come it was of absolute no use at all food was mediocre at best what a disappointment for Mother's Day brunch I would rather go to McDonald's next time
reviews.author: Jason And Christina H.

reviews.text:
Just flew in the night before and got off to a lazy vacay start with a brunch. 

Arrived and was promptly seated outdoors. The view over looking *i think* was great. You're also over looking the pool area as well. Make sure you get the story about the Harris Hawk, Blaze. More than likely you'll figure it out. 

We got Mimosas, the Egg White Frittata and the Quinoa bowl. All the options were good, especially for vegetarians, I preferred the Quinoa bowl as it boasted multiple flavors and textures, especially with the poached eggs. 

5/5 for ambience 
5/5 for food
 
Overall 5/5 for brunch.
reviews.author: Stephen J.

reviews.text: This place is such a beautiful evening spot. Great views, amazing drinks (try their espresso martini) and awesome service!!!
reviews.author: Ashley H.

reviews.text: Came here for lunch on the weekend and had a reservation. The hotel is beautiful and this restaurant is located right off the pools. Given the location, the atmosphere is very casual-- feels somewhat confusing as there's a mix of some people who are dressed nicer and some who are in swimsuits. Service was really bad and slow, nobody to even refill water. We shared the chicken sandwich and salmon BLT. Chicken sandwich is supposed to be crispy but was actually quite soggy with the breading coming off and the bun mushy. Worst part was the salmon in the BLT was not cooked and quite obviously so... took a long time to bring it to anyone's attention because service is that MIA. Left hungry and unsatisfied. Definitely would not return here or recommend.
reviews.author: Michelle A.

reviews.text: Great patio for lunch! We enjoyed the serene surroundings on the patio near the pool. Service was great and I recommend the truffle artichoke and cheese dip. The food was generously portioned, healthy and subtle in flavor. If you're looking for a lighter lunch in a sunny spot with pretty views this is it!
reviews.author: Sara N.

reviews.text: We went there for breakfast twice. The Egg White Frittata with goat cheese & veggies was amazing! My husband enjoyed the huevos rancheros. The AvocadoToast and Lox Bagel were also delicious. Everything was fresh and perfectly prepared. Service was excellent. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Donna S.

reviews.text:
I would pick zero stars, but that was not an option. The service was severely lacking. Our first order of drinks took about 40 minutes to get. We were almost halfway through our meal before they arrived.  We asked for a condiment and it took another 15 minutes. The food was average at best for a restaurant in a luxury hotel.   I heard the word sorry no less than a dozen times with no real contrition or discount on our meal.  

This was literally the worst dining experience I have ever had.
reviews.author: Chris N.

reviews.text: Awesome place! Recommend everything was amazing- so much we kept coming back Raul was the best knew his drink recommendations and was patient with our group as the girls didn't know what they wanted!  All the drinks he recommended were amazing and can't wait to go back!
reviews.author: Esmeralda V.

reviews.text: We had the best time sitting at the bar with Raul! The service was above and beyond. He made us a tequila old fashioned that was amazing! We will definitely be back!
reviews.author: Jenine G.

reviews.text: Our waitress, Alysia, was amazing! We had an amazing dinner! Drinks were spectacular! If you want a great dinner and amazing service in Scottsdale this is the place.
reviews.author: Michelle T.

reviews.text: The food was great! We sat outside all days of our stay. Everything made me feel safe and we enjoyed the outdoors. Just didn't enjoy some of the servers. Most of the service was amazing at the Phoenician and can't wait to go back  just a little disappointing on some of the servers not as friends. Either way I had the salads and they were delicious and breakfast was always really good
reviews.author: Jessica F.

reviews.text:
Back at my favorite hotel in the world! Been coming here for 13 years now..since Mowry & Cotton was The Terrace! 
It's my favorite spot on the resort. 
Very peaceful here and service is on point. 
Food is always great! 

Christine has been here through all these years and she is hands down the BEST!! Always very friendly and helpful and goes above and beyond every time.
reviews.author: Gerald J.

reviews.text: Have eaten there twice. Lunch was fantastic and I can't say enough about the butternut squash soup with the cardamom marshmallow foam - the depth of flavor was amazing: 5/5 on that experience. However,  I went for brunch and was sorely disappointed in the waffle (nothing special at all, just one waffle, and way overpriced at $16) with chicken (just chicken tenders they put on top of the waffles for an additional $6, whereas I was expecting more of a chicken n waffles dish) 3/5 for overpriced brunch experience.
reviews.author: Sonya N.

reviews.text:
We had breakfast at Mowry  and Cotton and Shelly servers us 
Thanks Shelly we appreciate you

And another shout out to Austin
reviews.author: teri s.

reviews.text: Yo went for thanksgiving dinner it was excellent service awesome. People enjoying themselves a great time with great views. And great Turkey dinner
reviews.author: Arthur M.

reviews.text: This was a great place to have my birthday dinner. Food was  wonderful and the service was excellent.  Would definitely eat there again.
reviews.author: Ronda N.

reviews.text: Big disappointment, LAZY CHEF!! As another reviewer said, service was great - this is strictly on the chef and food. We ordered the bucatini pasta and it was a sad effortless dish. The pasta literally came with pesto sauce on one side, bucatini on the other and one full Calabrian chili!! Lazy! I'm not staying at then Phoenician and getting a dyi pasta dish. How does the chef have this gig? The waiter said it might have been due to speeding up time... it was hardly at capacity and how is that an excuse? I wish I had a picture and gotten a full refund for this horrendous effortless meal that is not cheap either....
reviews.author: Drai V.

reviews.text: The only open restaurant at the Marriott's Phoenician resort during my stay. Overall review: Lackluster service at dinner, mediocre food at best, and a complete miss at breakfast (cold food and missing items). While the manager did come by to apologize, which was appreciated, too many flops to rate this any higher than 3 stars. For a posh resort, that really doesn't cut it.
reviews.author: Daniel M.

reviews.text:
Really enjoyed the breakfast tacos and kids loved the avocado toast and fruit parfait. Love the ambience, music and great service. 

Will come back for lunch soon as everything was great
reviews.author: Ashish M.

reviews.text: Could have been better ; Could have been worse. I just expected more for a restaurant inside The Phoenician- the ONLY restaurant that is open during the week right now if you are a guest of The Phoenician. We dined here for breakfast. This was our first dining experience in the US after being in Mexico Marriott properties for a month. It's very different; and not for the better. We weren't even greeted ; we were just asked, 'how many ?' and then led to a table. How warm & welcoming. My husband gets complimentary continental breakfast as part of his Marriott perks. Coffee not included. Fruit not included. 18% gratuitous charge included. I ordered a cappuccino; the machine was broken our waiter said. He said I could walk to the Marketplace & get a to go' cappuccino, though. I asked if it would be 'working' tomorrow since we are booked here for several days; he said 'probably not'. For a Luxury Collection Hotel's restaurant, we aren't impressed. Please don't blame Covid. We have been living with it all year & again having just returned from Mexico & having stayed with the same chain, it's not acceptable for Marriott or any establishment to use that as an excuse. This waiter didn't care two bits. We ordered entrees as the breakfast voucher was worth $37.01 , ( yes, .01!) , in credit & it made more 'cents'. I had the breakfast tacos ($16) ; my husband a BLT breakfast sandwich ($17). His  was ample and tasty. Mine was small and soggy. We were very hungry as we flew a long day before from the Yucatán Peninsula barely escaping Hurricane Zeta .. ( a nasty Zeta !  Always the drama queen who can't handle a crowd! lol) Because we had arrived the evening before at about 9pm , surprised to see no restaurants open, and we were pretty famished. America is not like Mexico , for sure. The fruit we ordered was a small plate ; pricy but fresh. We came back for dinner last night because again, there's nothing else! We loved our waitress , Dora, who took note of my allergies. Suggested a good wine & even went so far as to go to The Thirsty Camel & grab us a Shrimp Cocktail that we couldn't get because we had an absent waiter up there ! The Avocado Caesar was great ! My husband's Hangar Steak was great ! My Buccatini Pasta with 4 small shrimp ( $12 add on ) was not so great .. it was dry & tasteless.  The parmesan cheese is not fresh and again for a restaurant, THE ONLY restaurant open during the week at The Phoenician, right now. You would think the service , and that starts with the hostess staff , and the menu would be TOP notch.. and btw, it's not that hard to get a espresso machine working for your guests when they are paying a premium to be here rather than telling them to walk to the Marketplace and get one 'to go' themselves. 2.5 stars rounded up.
reviews.author: Kimberly V.

reviews.text: As a guest at the Phoenician, I decided to try out the restaurant on site for breakfast. I ordered the Kale Quinoa bowl and then a kids order of pancakes (gotta indulge a bit on vacation!). Both dishes were so tasty that I didn't leave any behind. It felt like they might have been a bit short staffed with service though as it took a long time to get my bill. Food came out quick though. Giving them a shot for dinner another night.
reviews.author: Nicole N.

reviews.text: Very nice people and excellent service. Food for dinner just "okay". Small pasta serving with pesto on the side was oversalted, and at $24, ridiculously priced. Prawns a bit overcooked, were an additional $6. Husband had same pasta, but with chicken. Nothing special. Definitely not fine dining. We've had lunch here and it's fat and salt, you know...burgers and fries, and it's good. Lunch experience outside on the patio worth the extra bucks, but this is resort food. Go somewhere else for your birthday or anniversary.
reviews.author: Susan M.

reviews.text: We stayed at the hotel for a week.  During our stay we ate dinner (twice) and breakfast.   We also had drinks at the bar.  Can't say enough about the staff.  Helpful, professional and kind.  The food was high quality and flavorful.  I highly recommend this restaurant and hope that people continue to return.  The staff made the best of a difficult time.
reviews.author: Lisa C.

reviews.text: What should have been a great evening  with family was shrouded with poor service and numerous inconsistencies up too and including food being sent back How bad a dining experience ?  I'm glad you asked. The entire dinner for four was compt ,  appreciation to management for doing that but all in all it does not change the dining experience,  it should never come to that . Multiple disconnects between staff ,management and kitchen . a prevalent theme of serving apologies , it was only after requesting a manager and waiting 15 minutes (yes you may wait that long  you should be use to that by now ) before this was addressed . This is not a Covid issue , staffing was more than ample for the amount of guest . This goes to the core of restaurant management 101 and somebody needs to go back to school
reviews.author: Brenda M.

reviews.text:
Let me be clear, service is 5 stars, our server was amazing and apologetic. The reason for the three stars is indeed our server. ISSUE, we had 11:30am reservations on a Sunday, we downloaded the menu on our phones and when our server came we gave him our order and we were told that they were now on the lunch menu, it's 11:45am on a Sunday!!!! He went to check with the kitchen and was told yes only lunch, he was so apologetic and I know it wasn't his fault. 
THEN When I got home I checked their website at the resort and when you scroll to the bottom sure enough "join us for weekend brunch Saturday and Sunday 10:30 - 2:30pm, with a live DJ...........??? So now I am mad! I am certain we were there on a weekend and certain within the time frame yet we seem to be missing brunch and a DJ ?????
