UPDATE your website ASAP I really wanted to give 2 stars but our server didn't charge us for the coffee, We felt bad for him so we left him a good tip.
reviews.author: Clinton F.

reviews.text: Came here for dinner cuz J and G was close and I have to say service was slow, it's so bright inside and outside and our food came out cold not warm at all! Food was ok overall! We stay here but won't be coming back to this restaurant!
reviews.author: Tammi N.

reviews.text:
First time Saturday  had lunch on the patio of Mowry and Cotton   It was good but not great
Patio 5 stars server Kyle I would give 5 stars  She was  excellent and very attentive  and treated us to birthday dessert.  My friend had Avocado Benedict. Excellent. 
I opted for crispy chicken breast sandwich on brioche
Tasty but Chicken breading was way over fried and a little dry   I up charged for fries as a side.  Which was fine.  Only comment on fries was the oil had a strange taste like needing to be changed or other foods besides fries cooked in it    Dessert the brûlée olive oil cake was delicious with rhubarb and strawberries

reviews.text:
Stopped by for breakfast and later attempted dinner (no seats available for dinner but the entire patio had mostly unused tables). I think the presentation is creative but the meal lacked structure. I ordered a frittata with a side of bacon, the frittata was great however, the ingredients weren't spread out evenly, so half the meal was bland. The goats cheese was a good touch and the salty bacon topped it off. 

Limited options for someone as picky as me. Most of the meals had high carb/sugar content.
reviews.author: Sieraaj A.

reviews.text:
Beautiful ambiance, pool side patio, nice bar, good service but the food and wine list doesn't live up to its potential.

The soup was salty. The flatbread was a bit burnt. This resort doesn't allow to bring your own wine, sad. 

The Moscow Mule, dog friendly & the good service saved the day!
reviews.author: Manda Bear B.

reviews.text:
Don't discount this place because of it's location -- we almost did and were so happy we dined here! 

The menu looks.. weird. But this was the most interesting meal I've ever had. Morgan, our server, was very knowledgeable about the menu and helped us make the best choices for dinner. The restaurant had a beautiful view and the dining area was really pretty. 

We had the rolls, butternut squash tortelloni, salmon and scallops. The food was amazing, the service was great -- we will definitely be back.
reviews.author: Morgan C.

reviews.text:
Mowry & Cotton is a Modern American Restaurant located in the Phoenician luxury Resort and Spa in Scottsdale. They offer indoor dining seating and a very large patio with views of the grounds, vast pool area and the mountains. This was my third visit and things were different this time. I do have a Scottsdale Preferred Card that gets me one meal for free. I called to make my reservation and told them that I have the card. When I got there they told me that my card is only good for dinner but the'd let me use it since the girl on the phone that took my reservation didn't know.

I ordered the seared ahi tuna sandwich ($18) because I tried it before at a festival and it was delicious there. We waited a half hour for our plates to arrive. My tuna sandwich didn't taste like what I tried at the festival. It also only was made with a few shavings of tuna. It doesn't resemble another picture of the same sandwich someone else posted on Yelp.I don't know if they ran out of tuna or if they cut my portion of food because I had a preferred Scottsdale card? So I was pretty upset and disappointed the next day when I saw the other Yelp Photo of the same plate.

My husband's plate of green chile pork shank was tender and also was a nice large portion ($18.) He said it ran on the bland side and would have preferred more spice and flavor. (maybe it was an off batch)

Service was excellent on my last two visits but this time I might have gotten a new server or maybe someone that had more tables than they could handle. We weren't offered refills. We waited a very long time for our server to come to the table and also when we finished. We were going to order dessert because we enjoyed fancy desserts here but this person placed the check. They took our preferred Scottsdale card and didn't make it back for a very long time. It took one and a half hours for our day time meal. (that is a long time). After this visit I don't know if I want to return.

Oddly when I got home I got a message on my answering machine from Mowry and Cotton telling me that I can't use my card for my reservation. They left the message after I was already on my way to make it there or maybe when I was already there.

The exclusions on the Scottsdale Preferred Card need to be updated for Mowry and Cotton. The Card Reads Excluding holidays, special events and other promotions.

I understand service issues can and do happen everywhere but my main complaint is the sandwich after seeing someone else's sandwich on Yelp. I don't know if they gave me less because of my card or if this was a random circumstance. Either way it was disappointing.
reviews.author: Laura A.

reviews.text: Excellent food/dining experience... from a charity auction they donated-- highly recommend.  I had the pork streak and apple crumb pie.  The apple crumb pie was outstanding (not a pie)
reviews.author: Eric H.

reviews.text: Mowry & Cotton is located inside the Phoenician resort. It's tucked away on the lower level of the resort but has an extremely comfortable feel and atmosphere. We enjoy dinner here twice and highly recommend. First off, they're flat breads are excellent! We had their roasted squash flatbread and it absolutely melts in your mouth. We also had their charred hanger steak, excellent and tender and a great seasoned taste. Their prime pork steak is a must! I'm not a big fan of ordering pork at medium temperature, but the flavors of the coating popped out with each bite. As far as service goes, they are top notch. Christian, Art, and Doba, were very accommodating and attentive. Christian even recognized us the next day and continued with his excellent service. I highly recommend Mowry and Cotton!
reviews.author: Dan K.

reviews.text:
I decided on the chicken pot pie just because I kind a wanted some comfort food and CPP does the trick.

Unfortunately I wasn't too impressed with it. I felt it to be rather devoid of much inside stuff you know the chicken pot part of the pie. By the picture it looks kind of large but it was mostly air and I kept digging down looking for the filling. When I did discover it I found it to be too salty as well. It wasn't bad enough to send back but I don't rate much critically on Yelp. Food and me like each other. $23 for it was a big stretch. Maybe I've had too many in English pubs that leave me feeling like plowing a field after I've eaten. 

So I ate it and left unfulfilled. My Old Fashioned was good though. 

The place, the grounds are beautiful, Phoenician. The CPP, not so much. 

Service 4/5
Food 2/5
Location 5/5
reviews.author: John C.

reviews.text:
I sit here for the second day in a row as I write this. Probably one of the top five worst experiences (two days in a row) I have ever had at a restaurant. What is truly unbelievable about this horrible service is that Mowry & Cotton is at the Phoenician. 

They just don't have their stuff together starting with the inept hostess. Moving on to service, staff is friendly if you can flag someone down. Order a simple cup of coffee and it comes 10 minutes later? Speaking of coffee, don't get cute and no put spoons on the tables. (They set their tables without spoons). "Do you need cream with your coffee? Yes please. Do I really need to ask for a spoon as well? Should I stir it with my finger?"

The only good thing is going is the food. It's good! Omelettes are fantastic, very nice avocado toast. The only bad thing I had was chicken sausage that looked more like something picked up out at the dog run-see photo!  So good food and crap service? Sorry but I'm going with 100% service here. 

This travel agent probably won't be sending clients here anytime soon.
reviews.author: Kirke R.

reviews.text: Great atmosphere, the breakfasts here are great.  The choice of inside or patio dining is a good feature.  They also offer several healthy blended juices that are great.  Service is friendly and prompt.
reviews.author: W J.

reviews.text:
Not that great. Service was good but the menu not for me. End up getting the shrimp which is pretty good but you don't get a side dish with it, just the shrimp. You might be able to get away with that at Mastro's or Ocean club but this place, absolutely not. 
It wasn't terrible. It looks like a cool place to go drink and hang out with friends. There were a lot of people doing that but didn't really notice anybody eating.  They must've gotten the memo about the  food. 
My husband got a steak And potato. Ordered the steak medium it came out closer to medium rare and a potato was old is hell. Steak and potato were not even lukewarm. We told the server and she removed from my bill which was nice. Not her fault and left her a pretty big tip.
reviews.author: Sandy R.

reviews.text:
Not to good. I got a steak with a baked potato. Ordered my steak medium. It was closer to rare. Potato was old as hell. Like 4 days old. Very bad. Got some sort of butter bun as an  appetizer. It was like an old hamburger bun with some margarine for $8. 
I would have rather had McDonalds. Much higher quality.
reviews.author: Jerry D.

reviews.text:
I absolutely loved the pheasant "zoup" ($10) here but was meh on everything else. I got one of their bowls, with shrimp, quinoa, sweet potatoes, sugar snap peas, bok choy, radishes, and a few other things, but found it pretty bland. The drink selection wasn't all that exciting for me either. They serve all three meals and it's a big space with a bar area just inside, an interior dining room, and a huge patio (with misters) bordering the pool area outside.

But that pheasant zoup was so good I went back to have it again. Lots of pieces of chopped grilled pheasant in a poultry broth and mirepoix base with some grains for body and plenty of fresh herbs in a hearty serving size. It's worth a trip to have that for lunch.
reviews.author: Adam B.

reviews.text:
I enjoyed meeting up with a couple of friends here. Mowry & Cotton opened up at The Phoenician in 2007. It is named after two businessmen (George Mowry and James Cotton) who came to Phoenix in 1872 and opened the first fine liquor establishment in downtown Phoenix. They were trying to create more of a community feel instead of the typical saloons that were around. Chef Tandy Peterson has created a nice rustic menu of comfort food that pays homage to meals that were cooked over a fire back then. The concept here is a shared dinner menu that you mix and match with the people at your table. They have several choices of meat and fish to choose from like salmon, sea bass, steak and ribeye. They also have a variety of popular flatbreads (or pizzas). Other choices are salads, vegetables and appetizers. They have several cocktails to choose from like their signature Washington & 1st drink (gin, elderflower, blackberry, lime, thyme and bitters). They are also open for breakfast and serve brunch on the weekends. The staff wears button down shirts, suspenders and leather boots to reflect the times. For decor, there are old distillery bottle all around the restaurant that plays off the lighting that comes in to create an ambiance feel of the Old West.

Mowry & Cotton has been running a special Summer Culinary Countdown menu that includes a Bottle and Board for $25. It comes with a choice of a bottle of wine and a flatbread. We tried the Roasted Squash Flatbread and the A to Z Pinot Gris bottle of wine. For dinner, I ordered the Grilled Pheasant. It was tender and smokey and comes with lots of fixings like almonds, onions, broccolini and cherries. Others at my tabled ordered the Chicken Pot Pie, the Corn and Chorizo Dip (with Chicharrones) and Grilled Potatoes. We enjoyed trying one another's food over good conversation. This has been a great new addition to The Phoenician. The rest of the evening was spent in The Phoenician Cactus Garden and enjoying the beautiful views of Phoenix from the lounge area.
reviews.author: Travis T.

reviews.text: We loved the service and food at Mowry and cotton. We were a jet lagged group of 10 and wanted somewhere to sit and eat and relax. Most of us got salads and they were all great. We especially loved the warm hospitality and great decor. Will definitely be back!
reviews.author: Stacey S.

reviews.text: In a word... "Yummy." Really delightfully thoughtful takes on all menu offerings. This was our second time visiting and it was just as delicious as the first time. We dined off the Spring Restaurant Week menu and were pleasantly surprised at the portions and offerings. All items are also on the regular menu (I think!) The steak was cooked to perfection, lovely pink in the middle, seasoned perfectly with a crispy crust. The pork chop was spectacular - even better than the steak. Their wine list is dreamy, and the sides were so good. The beet salad was especially terrific. For desert we loved the lemon pie - super lemon flavor, a teeny bit tart and a teeny bit sweet. Delish. Service was very nice - midweek, not to terribly crowded either. We'll be back!!
reviews.author: Deb S.

reviews.text:
Here for the buffett which was great. Food options were high quality and better than most other hotels I have EVER been to. View is the pool and fantastic. Lots of shade but still bright and lively. Even had many gluten free options and fresh kale juice blend. Service is very friendly and attentive. Some of the food options were what they serve at afternoon tea which was a delightful surprise. 
Worth coming back for!
reviews.author: Jeremy G.

reviews.text: Love this place - food is wonderful but the service is even better. We try to dine here about once a month. Quiet (great for conversation with friends). A bit on the expensive side but hey, it's the Phoenician. Best Ribeye steak I've had in a long time.
reviews.author: Kevin L.

reviews.text: Amazing food and amazing ambiance!!!! We had lunch which was PHENOMENAL and did the 2:00 mixology class with Myron which was so fun and we learned how to make amazing cocktails!!! Highly recommend
reviews.author: Jamie R.

reviews.text: Rachael is the nicest server. She made our lunch experience great. Suggested food and desert and wasn't wrong as everything was great. I had the ahi tuna sandwich and my husband had lamb tacos. Yum yum. We had bread putting with Lime chipotle ice cream, awww so great. Thanks Murphy's
reviews.author: Mary M.

reviews.text:
I have been to Cotton & Mowry a couple of times, including on a couple of date nights with my husband and dinner with our kids. Their concept is pretty cool, where it's like a shareable style of a modern American menu.

We have tried a couple of their menus and every single time we finished our meals we were already looking forward to our next time! Service has always been wonderful, and the food simply incredible, to the point where we were either speechless or  %  letting out a YUUUMMMM or a OH MY GOSH - kids included!! There's something on menu for anyone, and if you haven't been there yet, gooooo and give it a try! With the weather now being perfect for the outdoors, the patio sitting provides a nice view as well. The atmosphere is casual and nice. 
I was trying to choose a few of our favorite dishes, but it's honestly so hard to!! I'll add a few, but there's nothing we have had that we would not want to have again!

Buttermilk Buns, The Squash or the Roasted Tomato Flatbread

Side:
Mowry french fries

From the starters:
Corn &Chorizo dip  

Vegetables:
Grilled asparagus 
Crispy potatos
