"Prime" Pork Steak

Dessert:
Apple crumble
reviews.author: Sue P.

reviews.text: The view is ok, drinks ok, have Good food but Slow service! Best part is the guy who walk around with eagle .
reviews.author: Iphone A.

reviews.text: We came here with the family of 4 and really enjoyed it. They serve some dishes family style and the food was really good. Highly recommend the pheasant and the peppers. The service was good too. Just the right amount of attention.
reviews.author: Paul M.

reviews.text:
I had dinner here midweek with my kids and young children of a friend. My wife was out of town- so it was me and a menagerie of kids. I have to say, M&C was not my first choice, but it turned out to be a good choice. It has a very reasonable kids menu and all the kids ate off of that, so all 4 were about $55. I had the steak and if was reasonable. I could not drink, but the I did eye the wines and it was not outrageous like J&G.

Food 4- like the kids and adults food
Wine 4- had reasonable list, 2x prices- I eyed Caymus at $175 and just bought a bottle a few days ago for $85 at Fry's
parking 4- valet the car and it was validated - so only a $5 tip- but still far from the restaurant
Atmosphere 4- very nice setting, ate inside since it was raining and very cold outside
service 5+ - we had Samantha and she was amazing. One of the best people to tend a table. The maitre'd was pissy poory, but Samantha made up more than enough for it
desert 4 - had donuts (they had a different name for it)
value 5 - with the kids meal, it was a very reasonable dinner

overall 4

I have to say compared to J&G which is arrogant and mediocre, this was a great night out. Maybe Samantha made the difference since she was attentive, but given my horrible experience at J&G and I will never go there again, I certainly will go back to M&C. I did not give it 5 stars since it did not hit a home run with the food, but if there was half stars it would be 4.5 stars
reviews.author: Rocker 1.

reviews.text:
Mowry & Cotton was a surprisingly good dining experience. Our party of six was comfortably seated in front of the open kitchen which gave us an opportunity to visit with the chefs and sous-chefs. I watched Lexi (cordon-bleu trained sous-chef) prepare the blistered shishito peppers and whole sea bass. The peppers were spectacular! Everyone enjoyed their mains: mussels, salmon, ribs and burger. 
    This is a mostly female-staffed kitchen which turns out inventive cuisine. Service is excellent--attentive and fast
    We finished with great desserts--I loved the homemade molasses ice cream which accompanied the apple crumble 
     We will definitely return
reviews.author: Hal G.

reviews.text:
Absolutely FANTASTIC! We were guests at the Phoenician and decided to stop in late Saturday night.  We were greeted with our names when we arrived, staff from host to server were so kind and polite. We ordered the rib eye, fried potatoes, mussels, and donuts. The chef had a unique spin of charred ingredients in the dishes. All of the entree came perfectly prepared.  Rib eye was perfectly prepared with pork belly and a sauce on top.  Mussels were cooked in a delicious base with chorizo and buttery toasted bread.  The fried potatoes were quite unique with delicious toppings. I would order all the dishes again! They were kind to bring out a complimentary bun with two delicious butter spread...sweet and savory. 

Even if I was not a hotel guest, I would try this place! It's tucked into the mountain, away from the busy Scottsdale. Kudos to the staff for making it an amazing date night!
reviews.author: B A.

reviews.text:
Food is decent but service is absolutely terrible. I was staying at the Phoenician resort for a convention and the hotel was well aware that hundreds of not thousands of people would be congregating the hotel and dining at their restaurants. When we came to Mowry and Cotton half the tables must have been empty but there were about 15 parties waiting for a table. They claimed they were understaffed and could not accommodate all of us at once... a bit ridiculous right?! 
When we finally sat down, the food was good and the services was okay but not something I would come back for.
reviews.author: Melanie G.

reviews.text: We had the chicken flatbread, lamb tacos, and halibut. Everything was delicious! The star of the show was probably the lamb tacos. It's only 3 small tacos but it's worth it as an appetizer. Since this restaurant is located at the beautiful Phoenician, the views from this restaurant are amazing. I really enjoyed everything about my experience here.
reviews.author: Maysa M.

reviews.text:
This used to be my go to brunch spot for a while, so when I recently visited Phoenix I wanted to dine here again. I'll admit, my recent experience was not as positive as my previous experiences but I'm going to say that was because it was an anomaly. I've never dined here other than for brunch, it's beautiful to sit outside on the patio on sunny days, however today we were stuck in the sunniest table without an umbrella. Fortunately, the waiter was able to bring over an umbrella to shade half of our table. It's also neat to see the service they hire to keep birds away from diners. A man brings his hawk and stands around the area, the hawk scares the other birds so they will leave the diners alone. 

On this visit my fiancé and and I split the chorizo and egg tacos, Brussels sprouts and crispy potatoes. The tacos were really good as were the veggies. I also got a flight of the Fromosa's, which I wasn't very impressed with. I think they've recently changed the sparkling wine they used for them because they tasted flat. Or they just used an old bottle, not sure. Either way, disappointing. We ended up getting an order of the monkey bread as a dessert for the table. The part with the sauce was really good, otherwise the bread was dry.
reviews.author: Jenny S.

reviews.text: Came for a holiday dinner with my best of friends and one of the server assistants blew us all out of the water. Being a part of the service industry we all have high expectations and Citaly was wonderful. An absolute gem with her stellar service, and so bright with all of her menu knowledge and recommendations. If you don't hire her as a server idk if you're doing much right Mowry&Cotton! Otherwise, great food, great ambiance with the best company! Merry Christmas!
reviews.author: Zachary N.

reviews.text:
This restaurant is located inside the Phonecian Resort. Even though I have been living in Scottsdale for over three years now, This was only my second time at the Phonecian and first time at Mowry and Cotton. 
This is a beautiful resort and we chose to sit outside, it being a beautiful, sunny winter day. Both my daughters and my two grandkids were with me. 
Our server was a lovely young lady who was especially friendly with the little ones. 
We made our selections and the food arrived in short order. The presentation was very attractive and as we had our first bite it was clear that the quality was equally good. A little bit later my daughter discovered a problem with her burger, serious enough that it was the end of her meal. 
We informed the server who immediately realized the gravity of the issue. She apologized and hastened to take the dish in question back to the kitchen. 
In a short time the manager, dapperly clad, was at our table and profusely apologized, no if's and buts. 
What I was most impressed with was the way in which the staff handled the situation and made everything right. It was done in a way that was superbly professional. It reminded me of customer service that is a standard in Asian restaurants but not very often witnessed in the States. 
All I can say is "kudos" to the staff and the management that had trained them so well. 
I will indeed return.
reviews.author: Harris M.

reviews.text:
I came to Mowry & Cotton after a day of continuing education training in conference center at the Phoenician. It was convenient step out of the conference center and head to a restaurant within the Phoenician for some happy hour! The best thing about Mowry & Cotton is the decor. It has a mid-century modern vibe that I absolutely love. It's beautifully decorated, with perfect lighting, leather accents, lots of wood, and large plaid chairs! It's how I wish my living room at home could look! It's modern, masculine, and very trendy. 

I had a couple glasses of wine. I started with a pinot noir, but it wasn't my favorite, so I switched to a cabernet sauvignon. And I really liked it! We had the veal meatballs. They were slightly pink in the center, which worried me. We also tried some flatbreads. I really liked the salami one!

Resort restaurants, like Mowry & Cotton, have always kind of been odd to me. It seems like the food is usually slightly lower quality than similarly priced restaurants outside of a resort. I'm undecided if I'll be back.
reviews.author: Kathleen K.

reviews.text: Seems strange that we just stayed at the hotel for breakfast but I was pleasantly surprised!  Some of the best breakfast tacos I have ever had!  Large portion and very flavorful.  Fresh squeezed juice is a must have at this place. Atmosphere was very nice but relaxed.  Again the service at the hotel is amazing and it is the same at this restaurant.
reviews.author: Wendy K.

reviews.text:
There's a falconer here. He walks about the tables. His shirt is pressed. He wears aviators. His falcon, beady eyed. Brown feathers. The falconer and his falcon, both in brown uniform. 

I wait for a bison burger and fries, and news from my ex/publicist. It's good that it's quiet here. I enjoy the privacy. I can take phone calls. The only real company I share at Mowry and Cotton on a Friday afternoon, is the falconer and his bird. 

I squint toward the hills thinking I'm on some orange planet, much closer to the sun. That cacti are alien things. Scorpions are land lobsters and falcons eat the smaller birds trying to snag food from Phonecian clientele. If a little bird took my french fry, I'd be glad for the falcon to scare it away. But kill the bird for a french fry? That seems harsh. 

The life lessons one can be reminded of while eating a bison burger by a resort swimming pool, I think. 

The service here is a bit slow. But that's what vacation is for. Since selling my first fleet of paintings, I seek little resorts like this. Little weekends of burgers and Tinder. And I'm not going to complain a lick about the service because the detail at Mowry & Cotton, down to the napkin, is as well-curated as anything I've seen. And, I love chefs who don't flinch. The bison meat is hardly cooked. Just as I asked for it. Bloody.

What stops the falcon from pillaging my table? His owner. The fear of dying. Life really is, for the falcon and all of us here at the Phonecian, exploit and be exploited. It's how I can afford this lunch, this stay, this lovely hotel. People took advantage of the system and used me as a pawn. I try to remain true to the beautiful things in life, like this bison burger. 

Green chili. Bacon. Tiny fried onions. Fries in a vessel, fancy. An iced tea in the hot sun.When I walked into the restaurant, the hostess called me by my last name. Later, I'll sit by the pool with one of their chopped salads. A glass of Chardonnay. To whom do I owe the privilege of this experience here? I'll find out in a few minutes with that phone call. 

The falconer is kind enough to kneel and introduce me to the bird. Though I'm wary of befriending yet another predator. I avoid eye contact, and sip my tea.
reviews.author: Jamie B.

reviews.text: Mowry and Cotton is pretty good for a hotel restaurant but just okay compared to the world outside of the hotel property. I had dinner here at the bar, while finishing up some work. It was quiet - just one other person at a table on the other side. I tried the barbecue charred beets as well as the shrimp. Both were tasty and came out quickly but didn't wow me. My cocktail was also just okay. I probably wouldn't come back unless I were back at the Phoenician again.
reviews.author: Katie B.

reviews.text: I never ate here but while staying at the resort I took advantage of the activities that were included in the resort fee. One of the activity was a cocktail mixology. I was able to learn how to make certain drinks that they make here. We had 3 cocktails to try plus a champagne to start. I would come here again when I am in the area.
reviews.author: Jason Y.

reviews.text: I got the ahi tuna sandwich (the waiter recommended) which was mediocre and disappointing actually for such a high end restaurant. My salad wasn't fresh and some leaves were turning yellow. My son got the super hero burger which is more like a slider and the meat was burnt. The total bill was $34 :/ I would never order this again.
reviews.author: Farnaz N.

reviews.text:
Came here recently for AZRW because why go anywhere else but one of the Valley's hottest and newest places? Also... The Phoenician has killer views, even after sunset. They take OpenTable, so that's how I made my reservation. 

I arrived a little earlier than the reservation so I could get a good drink and take I the ambiance. Took a little walking to from the parking garage but the Phoenician staff were quite helpful! I parked a spot at the bar and Dino asked me what I was interested in. He gave a few recos based on what I like to drink and I went with the Old Orchard. I ended up having a few more during the evening, it was a nice refreshing drink for those (still) warm evenings. Our group got a nice table outside with fans above to keep the air flow going. The food, ambiance and conversation were absolutely amazing with my crew. Good bread (and duck fat butter), salad (with pheasant) and steak is all I need to make me a happy person. 

Unfortunately our night ended on a bit of a sour note with the service. We got our AZRW entrees, and within 10 minutes a server was bringing out dessert. Uh, friend, we don't eat entrees that quickly. It was a good 10-15 minutes after we actually finished that we were able to flag down a server for dessert. Then another ~20 minutes for our server to ask how to split up checks. Then another ~10 minutes for him to come back with the checks. Then another ~10 minutes for him to return with our validated parking passes. At some point during then, they turned off the fans, so it started getting very hot. 

It's not the timing and that we had somewhere to be. It's the principle of the matter that because we asked them to delay dessert service just a little bit, and as a result, the wheels fell off the service wagon. It felt like pulling teeth to finish up the meal and cash out. Damper on a lovely meal at a lovely place.
reviews.author: Alex W.

reviews.text:
Had a birthday dinner here last night and walked away with mixed emotions. Let's start with the good. The food is tasty and the portions are large. They use a nice mix of flavors to keep tastes bright and let the flavor of the dish ring through. However, the menu is limited. 

Now, if I were to rate this on food only it would have had a higher star rating. But, the service was terrible. The restaurant was not full...not even close...and 3 different servers had to come by the table to get drink orders, deliver/pour wine and actually take orders. This was not their "style" of service, just our waiter seemed to be absent a lot. I had to flag him down for the check and then waited over 15 min for someone to flag down to take my credit card...and it was NOT my server. We were with my son who was getting squirmy and was tired, so the longer we waited the more painful the sitting was. 

If they want to have success, beyond just guests of the hotel, they have to improve their service.
reviews.author: Todd G.

reviews.text: Beautiful space, good service. Food is sub par. We ordered several starters, a couple of vegetables dishes, and two entrees. All were "Meh" at best. In a city where GREAT restaurants are on every corner, Mowry & Cotton is going to have to seriously up their game if they want to be a contender.
reviews.author: Amy D.

reviews.text: Great food, slooooooow service.  It took almost 30 minutes to receive a menu other than the wine and cocktail.  We sat on the patio on a beautiful evening, only to be overwhelmed by a very loud DJ for a kids party that felt the need to yell and scream for the kids the entire two hours we were seated.  Overall, just not a good experience.
reviews.author: Frank S.

reviews.text:
We came for brunch around noon. The food is good with a variety of healthy juices and of course some great boozy options. 

I loved the turkey and sweet potatoes hash and the breakfast tacos. Service is okay, a little slow but we weren't in a hurry. 

I had to share the picture of the falconer which is their natural way of controlling pests and more invasive birds.
reviews.author: Joe C.

reviews.text: We ate here with friends and enjoyed the whole experience. The staff was attentive and right on with placing orders, taking dirty dishes, filling glasses -- they were great, and the timing of our food coming out was perfect. The menu offered an enticing variety of options. All tasted fantastic and was fresh and great quality and quantity. The view of the pool and grounds was gorgeous and we ate outside, surrounded by misters. It was easy to talk and relax. Inside was hip and seemed like another great choice in atmosphere. Great spot.
reviews.author: C Z.

reviews.text:
We had both dinner & brunch at this place. I would recommend their brunch over dinner. I personally they have better brunch menu. 

I would highly recommend the monkey bread & shrimp & grits on their brunch menu. The monkey bread was so soft and drizzled with cream cheese and fig jam. Absolutely delightful, I could have easily devoured the whole order on my own. 

The shrimp & grits was very tasty too. It was garnished with crispy garlic and bacon. Yum!! 

As for dessert, I would recommend the donuts and the s'mores. The s'mores was super duper rich with dark chocolate. The apple crumble was not bad but I would not recommend the bread pudding.
reviews.author: Melly T.

reviews.text:
This is an upscale dining option at a super fancy resort. I attended a work dinner here for about 20 people in a private space. First, the space is fun and attractive but the service was slow. We were supposed to start eating at 6:30 and the first course was clearly almost ready and sitting out on the side near the kitchen when I arrived at 6:20 but we ended up waiting longer than made sense for such a quiet night. I ended up leaving by 8pm although the courses had not yet all been served. It was also a little tedious to eat your entree off a communal plate. For example, three the lamb tacos were skewered together on a single serving plate but the idea was that each of us got to take one. Weird.
The food was good, though. Creative combinations. The house made buttermilk brioche bread was good with a duck fat fig jam.  I don't know what my employer paid for this meal but I don't think I would pick this place for a large group again.
reviews.author: Pras C.

reviews.text: Attentive, knowledgeable staff. Flavor profiles are well above most valley restaurants, portions are on the smaller side (especially that tuna entree...I've had more stuck in my teeth than what was on the plate) and it's a little pricey but look where you are. I would come back and recommend it to my friends that don't mind splurging.
reviews.author: Ron F.

reviews.text: Between the service and the food this place is unbelievable. Now you can take that however you wish. I have traveled all over the United States and part of the world and I have never seen service and food this unbelievable in my life.
reviews.author: Rick H.

reviews.text: Fantastic dinner last night at this restaurant with friends. The potatoes were awesome, so was the shrimp, but my favorite was the striped bass.  They deboned it and had it ready to eat without much fuss. It was delicious. I'd highly recommend the bass for anyone. Plates are definitely shareable and the donuts for dessert are the perfect ending. Only callout would be that the server was preoccupied with a big party and didn't give us as much attention as we should have received.  She acknowledged it though and gave my wife a second glass of wine for free. The bussers were all over it though...almost too much. They tried to take a few plates long before we were ready to be done. Overall...great food, just need to the service to match.
reviews.author: Joshua B.

reviews.text: Friendly attentive staff. Great iced tea, though I guess that's hard to bungle. Nice view through large windows on deck over the pool. The chicken wings are different than your average wings with charred breadcrumbs and cashews with a yogurt and current sauce- they are awesome! The bison burger was better than the hamburger and the chopped salad  was fantastic with avocado, corn and black currents and pheasant.
reviews.author: Michael R.

reviews.text: Excellent food at a great value especially considering this restaurant is located within a hotel. We did not have a single dish we did not like. Over our three day stay on the property after the first night of food service at this restaurant we elected to keep coming back everyday for the rest of or stay. Yes, you can get nicer food elsewhere but this review is mainly about value. For our table of three each person got a salad, we all shared an appetizer and a salmon dish was shared amongst two people the bill totaled slightly more than $70 and every dish was of the utmost quality and had excellent flavor. Here is why it gets 4 stars though the value does not transgress into breakfast stay away from the orange juice they charge $5 for EACH orange juice which in my opinion is surprising coming from a Luxury Collection Resort, the Ritz Carltons or even the Four Seasons I've stayed at do not partake in this behavior. So for a table of three our orange juice bill totaled more than two of our entrees combined which is terrible value. I would understand it, if it was squeezed onsite (which I am really surprised they don't do) but not for some tropicana juice that comes in a half gallon carton for $4. It seems like all their beverage specials are screwed up too, me and my party were laughing about this but their 3 for $30 drink menu was hilarious due to the fact that no combination of the three drinks on the menu even added up close to $30 if you took the 3 most expensive drinks on the menu it was roughly $7 short of $30.
reviews.author: Will K.

reviews.text: We had brunch last Sunday. It was a lovely restaurant, big, bright and airy, with a huge patio overlooking the pool. We sat inside and enjoyed the fromosa flight (just get it. Seriously). We had the yummy breakfast bruschetta (the crab was probably what we liked least about the dish, which was otherwise delicious), hash (get the eggs how you want them) and chicken and waffles. Loved it all, which had great grilled flavor and smoke from the wood fired oven. The service was great. What do you expect from a resort? When i spend $100 on brunch I really want to enjoy it, so just relax and hang out. We were there just over an hour, so i didn't think service was slow, just....resort/#brunchlife perfect. You should valet because they will validate your ticket. It's just inside and down from the main entrance so if you want to walk off a few calories you can visit the cactus garden just outside the main entrance.
reviews.author: Ann C.

reviews.text: Deserves 3.5 stars.  For as good as the brunch was service was very lacking.  We were seated ( had a reservation) and except for water delivery we did not meet our waiter for at least 10 minutes.  It took us getting up twice asking for service before someone came with no apology or acknowledgement  that we had been waiting.  Surprisingly, they weren't that crowded and those around us seemed equally annoyed.  Brunch for two was over 100.00 bucks and for that price tag service should be exceptional not lacking.
reviews.author: Tina J.

reviews.text:
I'm sitting here at the restaurant.  In one hour we have received one drink.  The restaurant is not packed.  Grimly we trudge on and may finish dinner by next week.  Please don't come here unless you have nothing to do for a few days.  I'll report back on food taste in a few hours.



Update later that night - 
.... after we complained, all food dumped in table at once at hour 1.5 haha.  Food is pretty good?!  They did comp another round of drinks.  Other tables around us getting angry and hangry.  Vibe is very unpleasant.  I kinda feel bad for the server.   No manager visible. Don't COME HERE!!
reviews.author: richard o.

reviews.text: Horribly long wait times, overpriced, small portions, and incompetent staff. They need training and more chefs in the kitchen, not so many out walking around doing nothing.
reviews.author: Joshua E.

reviews.text:
This was the first date my man and I went to as official husband and wife! And it was a superb evening. My hubby told me to pick a place for dinner -- and I was craving the ooey gooey s'mores dessert -- so I booked Mowry & Cotton. (I think he had a mini heart attack when he saw the prices of the regular menu, but we were there to take advantage of their amazing $30/person shareable summer date dinner feast). 

We arrived for our reservation and my hubby at first wanted to make a run for it -- he thought I'd chosen a place that would break the bank, lol. We were seated at a cute little table inside and took in the beautiful sunset and sights, along with the great atmosphere and decor. 

Our polite server came over and took our drink order and we informed her that we wanted to take part of the summer date night menu, which she brought right over. And let me tell you, folks, this menu is no joke! Hubby said he'd probably leave hungry -- I told him not to speak too soon, and guess who was right?! Lol. Yup, we took to-go boxes because we couldn't even finish our dinner. 

The sweet summer date night deal includes their fresh-out-of-the-oven buttermilk buns, served with duck fat fig butter with wild blueberries and a citrus sea salt butter; one side dish (we ordered the Caramelized Cauliflower & Market Mixed Green Salad); one entrée per person (I ordered the Roasted Salmon & hubby had Smoked Spare Ribs); and dessert (the Lemon Meringue pie & of course I ordered the S'mores pie, too -- yes it was an extra charge but oh so worth it!)

The food was phenomenal, each course tastier than the one before. Hubby was happy too, and when the check came, he was pleasantly surprised that we hadn't broken the bank. If that's not a win-win, I don't know what is!
reviews.author: Lavinia C.

reviews.text:
A M A Z I N G!!
This place is so so good! The staff is so helpful! Everything on the dinner menu is served family style which means that the table gets to enjoy everything that is ordered. The food has so much flavor, and is plated amazingly! make sure to save room for dessert because that is also amazing as well!
reviews.author: William R.

reviews.text:
My favorite hotel restaurant experience ever! I recommend sitting outside of the weather permits. When the waiter comes to walk you through the menu have him tell you the story of the restaurant namesake as it will blow your mind.

The menu is pretty straight forward and the food is fantastic! Start with the bread and butter def can't wrong with those. 

Follow it with the Smoke Brisket Zoup, it is a hearty and flavor bowl of food.

We shared the lamb tacos which were tasty along with the Veal and Black Garlic Meatballs and last but not least the Charred Hanger Steak. Both of these were mouthwatering good! 

I unfortunately did not take any photos because I was enjoy the food so much!
reviews.author: Cesar R.

reviews.text: Loved the food, Service and wonderful ambiance. We had the shrimp and ahi and it was wonderfully prepared. Going back soon.
reviews.author: Harris H.

reviews.text:
Initially, we were excited to check out the new place for brunch, especially after the buzz/hype surrounding it.  Ultimately we ended up disappointed.  

The atmosphere/decor was trendy, however that was the only positive portion of the experience.  

The service was horrible, albeit it was a very busy brunch.  All the service staff appeared to be scrambling and all appeared to have too many tables, which was very palpable to us and the table around us.  Everything about the service experience was rushed, frantic, and choppy.  Upon being seated, it took 10 minutes for a member of the service staff to greet us or offer water - despite numerous servers, hostess and SA's walking by our table. 

We took advantage of the "fro-mosa"(champagne and sorbet) only to have two wine glasses delivered to our table with two scoops of sorbet, sans champagne.  The glasses remained that way for 10-15 minutes (despite the server stating he would be right back) before the champagne was finally delivered.  This also despite multiple service staff walking by our table.  Coffee service followed a similar pattern of delay waiting for creamer or a refill.  

We ordered the monkey bread, brunch BLT, and chicken and waffle which were all mediocre - perhaps because they were already overshadowed by the poor service experience.

Of note. We hold no personal fault to the individual server - he was trying his best.  He was purely a victim to the environment and culture.

Based upon the pulse of the entire staff, this restaurant appears to suffer from poor leadership practices.  I saw the manager present once on the floor, but he did not appear to be assisting staff.  Servers appeared to be assigned to larger sections beyond what they can reasonably manage. There appears to be lack of teaching or holding everyone accountable to a team service model.  The entire staff could benefit from a team service 101 training course.  

In summation, the food/cocktails may have been great, but the service cast a dark cloud over the entire experience which appears to be chocked up to poor training and management practices.  It seems like the restaurant feels as though they can skate by as they are attached to the Phoenician/Luxury Collection name.  But, nothing about it the experience met those standards.
reviews.author: Nate E.

reviews.text: We came in with little to zero expectations but we were more then pleasantly surprised! Our server Stephan recommended the Hanger Steak and Sea bass! Both were excellent suggestions from him and Hats Off to the Chef!!!!!  Deb makes a killer Jalapeño Margarita:) This place is a Winner!
reviews.author: Heather G.

reviews.text:
GROSS LACK OF INTEGRITY 

This is only my second yelp review. I only post if there is something seriously wrong with the establishment. So here's my story: 

Had a reservation for party of 7 to celebrate my mother's birthday. Saw this restaurant on Phoenix magazine Best of 2017-18. Appetizers were great. Highly recommend the biscuits and crab spin dip. Entrees were unfortunately underwhelming. However, the food is not why I'm writing this. 

Upon receiving the bill I noticed a large gratuity percentage of 25%. It doesn't state the actual numerical percentage, having been a former server for several years I just did quick math in my head. I didn't know that our server, LUIS, was standing behind me. I laughed out loud with a spontaneous "woah" reaction. Got my Card out and paid the bill. Luis came back and said he changed the gratuity back to the normal 18%. This immediately tells me that he knew I saw the previously overcharged amount. He offered no explanation. I paid the bill. 

Spoke with a manager asking what's the customary gratuity, he stated 18%. So how did I get 25. Luis had to of changed it manually he stated. He then said it's the computer screen malfunction and isn't registering inputs correctly and left it at that. No sorry, no deep apology for a very poor experience. He did not care. Upset I spoke to luis aggressively, making sure his dishonesty was recognized. 

It's my belief that Luis stereotyped me as a young guy that could not afford the bill and therefore could not afford the tip. I would have gladly tipped my standard 20- 22% but instead he got the 18. Overall probably the worst experience I've ever had service wise at a restaurant.

There was also no acknowledgement about my mother's birthday even though it was mentioned twice, at the time the reservation was made and when someone called to confirm the reservation.
reviews.author: Nickie I.

reviews.text: Solid brunch spot. This is a nicely decorated spot within the Phoenician resort. We sat outside and the misters were powerful enough to keep up with the heat. Our service was excellent. Our server, Myron, was absolutely stellar. The coffee was good and got topped off frequently. We shared the donuts which were good (the Bavarian cream inside was amazing). I went for lighter fare with the granola and yogurt dish. It was delicious and I appreciated that it was more yogurt than granola. The SO had the BLT (a breakfast version with eggs). I had a bite and it was very good, but probably not my favorite of that type of sandwich. At the same time it was tasty enough that I would consider ordering it in the future. Overall, this is definitely a nice spot for brunch, especially if you want to feel like you're not in the middle of the city.
reviews.author: Gigi S.

reviews.text: My husband and I decided to take part of their brunch along with either a Groupon/coupon that enabled us a free flight of Fro-Mosas with our meals.  Fro-Mosas are basically a scoop of sorbet topped with champagne.  (Yum) We ordered the theMonkey Bread, the breakfast tacos and the salmon salad.  The monkey break was just okay. I remember growing up making monkey bread and M&C's didn't quite compare, but it was still pretty good. The breakfast tacos were AMAZING!!!  (So much so that we tried to go back the next morning just for the tacos but we weren't able to get a reservation!) the tacos are stuffed with a fried egg, steak, little bit of guacamole and I'm probably forgetting some other ingredients... Last we ordered the salmon garbanzo salad which was pretty good. The dressing had an interesting flavor that i couldn't quite pinpoint what it was.  I've never really eaten beets before and that was a treat for me!
reviews.author: Lindsey C.

reviews.text: My brother and I visited for an event a couple of months ago, and were very impressed by the quality of their BBQ - beef, pork chicken and fish - all were amazing.  The service was attentive and friendly, and the setting overlooking the pool wasn't so bad either.  We will be back.
reviews.author: John H.

reviews.text: A hidden gem tucked inside an oasis in the desert. Tandy created an exceptional menu flush with an amazing collection of flavors.  The buttermilk buns, hanger steak, charred tuna, smoked spare ribs, flatbreads, BBQ beats and the made fresh donut dessert (boom) and on and on....The staff works hard to deliver great service.   Dino, Jacqueline and Ahmet were friendly and personal. Made the experience complete.  Thanks!
reviews.author: Noah L.

reviews.text: Resort breakfast with great vegetarian and vegan options for us. Though the classic breakfast entrees are predominant there are solid options for vegetarian. For me, blueberry and banana pancakes. For Jamie a Buddha bowl. And fresh fruit!  Awesome!
reviews.author: Jerry O.

reviews.text:
We stopped after work in on a slow Thursday evening for some drinks and snack and left (disappointed) after one drink. If a local is going to deal with resort prices, you should at least get resort-level service. 
The hostess wasn't warm or friendly and neither was our server. Additionally, service was slow and we didn't get water or napkins until we requested them.  The cocktail/mixed drink options seemed limited and sugary. The drinks we chose were fine but not spectacular and not sizable.  There weren't any "happy hour" specials.  
Our only highlight (which wasn't even that great) of the evening was their signature Buttermilk Bun. It was tasty and large enough to share for the table. However, the specialty butters (citrus and fig) weren't all that special or flavorful. 
Based on this experience, we will not bother returning for a full meal.
reviews.author: Kristin P.

reviews.text:
My family and I came here for a birthday brunch for my sister. PS: if you tell them there's a birthday when you make the reservation , they will have a plate of chocolate strawberries with "happy birthday (insert name here)" made beforehand.

At first impression, the place had a great open decor. There was live music on the patio (where we sat) and the service, despite some other reviews, was great. However, the service did go down in quality as the meal went on. 

We got the patio platter (the 10-course meal for a minimum of 3 people). Since we had 4 people, we also order an additional starter and entree while 3 did the patio platter. My goodness, was there enough food! It was actually too much...we ended up having tons of leftover. While the quantity was there, the overall quality lacked in my opinion. The pork shank that I got in addition was fairly dry. We don't love blue cheese (our fault for not asking to remove this), and the kale salad had it as a main ingredient. The shrimp and grits was a mix of very garlicy (if you have the grits by itself) and salty (if you had the shrimp by itself). The donuts was presented in a fun way where you could drizzle it with your choice of topping, but the donuts weren't quite worth the calories. The best one were the steak tacos and the chocolate dessert. If I come again, that would be what i get. Because we did elected to do the preset menu, things arrived in four separate waves. I'm not sure if the waiter didn't want to rush us or whatnot, but he was seldom seen. Also, when I went into the dining area to look for him, I didn't find him.

Lastly, we sat on the patio. There were birds of course. The problem was that the station area with water and other drinks closest to us didn't have a napkin or something covering them. The birds, as you can see in the picture, were all around it. Clearly, this is a sanitation issue. Also, one of the servers' assistant collected our dirty plates and left them on a tray by the station...which only drew more attention from the birds...not ok. This knocked it down to a 2 star for me.
reviews.author: Melinda T.

reviews.text: This is one of our favorite brunch spots!! I have been here at least 5 times in the last 5 months and it's consistently delicious!!! I haven't been here for dinner so I'm not sure why they have such mediocre reviews. The fromosa flight is always a good choice, especially on warm summer days. The food is also very flavorful and great when sharing with a  big group. Most memorable dish was the chicken and waffles, it had a very memorable smoky flavor, and the syrup complimented it very well. Aside from the food, the atmosphere is pretty cool,. They have a huge outdoor patio with tons of sunshine. If you are lucky they "hawk man" will come around with his hawk. They hawk's caretaker is very knowledgeable and answers all questions regarding his hawk.
reviews.author: Savitre S.

reviews.text: Awful restaurant! We live in the neighborhood, so we frequent the Phoenician. Because we enjoy J&G so much, we have given this restaurant three tries. The food is awful and the service is subpar. The unique thing is that this restaurant feels as if it should be better, yet it fails each time. Great resort, but restaurant.
reviews.author: Mike L.

reviews.text: Amazing ambience, friendly staff, and unforgettable menu! The dishes at Mowry and Cotton are comfort food with a unique twist. Every detail of the dish was intricately thought out and the flavors blend together so well. My group had the pleasure of having quite the spread but my recommendations are the buns, hanger steak, tuna, crispy potatoes, & spring onions! Definitely will be coming back.
reviews.author: Sam E.

reviews.text:
I can't RAVE enough about this place! I held my birthday party there on May 22nd and the experience was AMAZING!

Let's begin with the custom birthday cake. I requested a dark chocolate cake with fresh raspberries to serve 10 people. I was blown away when my cake was presented to me. Not only was it the MOST DELICIOUS CAKE I've ever tasted, it served 20 so there was plenty to take home. 

Every single item on the dinner menu is worth trying so I can't single out any one item, but if you go there for lunch please order the beef brisket sandwich.

I can't wait to return. My new favorite restaurant.
reviews.author: Jovan V.

reviews.text:
I sampled this restaurant during Restaurant Week 2018. To my great surprise the restaurant was empty at 6:30pm. The ambience and interior design  are both rustic and chic. The restaurant has a variety of seating options, a lot of tables for date nights, families and even a private room for a special event!
We ordered the meatballs and chop salad to start, which both delivered great flavor. 
$15 cocktails were on a weak side. 
Hanger steak was the star with a mushroom garnish. 
To finish this elevated dining experience we had bread pudding with ice cream. Yummy!
reviews.author: Max S.

reviews.text:
Not sure where all the hate is coming from for this place. We had an awesome dinner experience here. I'm wondering if people aren't understanding the concept of the menu. The dishes are meant to be ordered family-style and shared with the table, and they also come out as they are prepared, creating a stream of food and a prolonged eating experience. If you are looking for your standard, quick app/entree/dessert dinner then this is not the place to get it.

The food was universally good. The buttermilk buns are fantastic. They have a deliciously soft texture and are served with two awesome butters. The brussels sprouts and roasted spring onion were good, but the crispy potatoes stole show on the veg side of things. Shatteringly crisp outsides with creamy insides coupled with a fantastic sauce made these extraordinary.

From the fish section, we tried the salmon and the shrimp, and both were very good. From the meat section, the hanger steak had a really interesting blueberry marinade that was as unexpected as it was good. But what really stole the show was the pheasant. Beautifully crisp, fatty skin and a sweet, salty seasoning made this my favorite dish.

This place is perfect for a larger group that's willing to share as you get to sample a lot of different dishes, which is exactly what the menu was designed to do. You also get plenty of time to socialize as a stream of dishes come out of the kitchen.

I highly recommend it.
reviews.author: Brian L.

reviews.text:
Visited for restaurant week, food and service both excellent, good value for the money. very personable staff. Ordered veal meatballs and salad
as starters, both were very good. We both ordered the hanger steak rare and it was properly prepared and nicely plated. Very tasty. Deserts were
Bread pudding (cornbread and chipotle ice cream) and Lemon meringue pie both of which were not to our taste. We would definitely return in the future and highly recommend.
reviews.author: Edward P.

reviews.text: Went for afternoon lunch on the patio with my daughter for Mother's Day weekend! What a gorgeous atmosphere located by the pool. We enjoyed the chicken pesto flatbread with a couple of delicious cocktails! Our server was very friendly and helpful with our choices! It was really cool because they had a falcon on the premises for guests to admire while they dined or swam! My daughter loved the Phoenician and Mowry & Cotton! She wants to return her next visit!
reviews.author: Jacque C.

reviews.text:
My husband and I enjoyed breakfast two mornings in a row here. The food was fresh and the menu was perfect. Great options but not too many so it wasn't difficult to make a choice. The service was also great. 
The highlight was watching a hawk chase away the local birds from attempting to sneak food off of the tables. There was a service called Falcon Force which involved a friendly bird trainer who walked around the outdoor seating area with the goal of guiding his Harris Hawk named "Tony Hawk" to free the area of flying pests. 
If I am ever in the area again I would definitely dine here again.
reviews.author: Coryn S.

reviews.text: A friend recommended we check this place out. The Phoenician Resort is  beautiful so we sat on the patio that looks over the pool. Started with the buttery delicious rolls and then had the Fish, potatoes and cauliflower dish. Finished the lovely dinner with an apple cobbler. I like that the menu is designed to share a few items so you can try a little of everything as the potions are not too large but you will leave very satisfied
reviews.author: Amie G.

reviews.text: Came here for a Yelp Elite BBQ event and had a really awesome experience.  The 3 food stations were beautiful displays of meaty greatness.  The taco station featured a whole smoked hog which was very similar to Chinese whole roasted pig so I liked it very much.  The meat was succulent and the skin was very crispy.  I would have liked it salted a bit since I ate it by itself instead of building my own taco with it.  The second station featured a delicious smoked salmon with some interesting toppings including pomegranate, rather dry bbq chicken, and amazing buttery shishito peppers.  I had 3 plates of shishito peppers as it was my favorite item of the night!  The third station had very tender ribs and brisket but they weren't very juicy.  They definitely needed the barbecue sauce to wash them down.  Overall taste was quite good except the dessert station.  There were Whoopi pies, some peach cornbread, and a brownie with a custard-like layer on top.  While the presentation was pretty, they were stale and tasteless.  The service was amazing however!  The staff constantly cleared our many plates and it was as if they feared the water would fall below an inch of the rim of our glasses.  The event gave me the impression it was a bbq restaurant but upon checking their online menu, it seemed like a typical mid-range American restaurant inside of a hotel.
reviews.author: Sandi T.

reviews.text:
Wanted to check out brunch on their patio before the weather gets too warm. Though service was spotty, the food was beautiful and delicious.

I wanted to make a 10:30 reservation, but was told they don't take reservations before 11am. When I asked why since the website said they opened at 10:30, I received a confusing response about the reservation policy and actual business hours. Was told they could probably seat us, but no guarantee. When we arrived, just a few minutes before 10:30, the patio was already full, with several tables at the end of their meal. Very confusing.... Despite all that, we were seated right away, but then our server ghosted. Luckily, the patio falcon force kept us entertained while we waited. We eventually flagged someone down and things got back on track. From there, things were much smoother. 

Recommend ordering a bunch of things to share. 
- Citrus with dates and pomegranates were beautiful and so sweet
- Bruschetta with fluffy eggs, chunks of avocado, and cheese didn't have much of the promised crab, but was still tasty. The thick slice of buttery toast made this really filling.
- Roasted brussels sprouts- a huge pile of nicely charred halves served over a just-sweet-enough soy dressing and topped with beautiful bonito wisps. The pieces of pickled cauliflower balance it out perfectly
- Citrus salmon salad- I didn't notice any dill green goddess dressing or citrus flavors, but the dish (cucumber, poached salmon, roasted beets, avo, cabbage) was still tasty. Dressing definitely would have brought it together.
- Breakfast tacos- yum! These were filling with meat so tender it melted in your mouth

Overall- definitely a good place to brunch, especially if you have a group that likes to share.
reviews.author: Ryen B.

reviews.text: Wonderful atmosphere, outside seating was full but we still had great seats inside. The food was great, the ratio was a little off on the Buddha bowl, would have liked to see more granola however the dragon fruit gelato was a nice (cool) surprise. Everyone seemed to enjoy their food a lot. Reason for taking away stars: drink orders for myself and another person were forgot (reminded the waiter after the food came), they forgot kids menus for the younger kids. The older kid wanted to order an app as the breakfast item and was pressured by the waiter to order an entree as well. One of the kids yogurts was brought out just plain, missing the fruit and other toppings. It was really hard to get a waiters attention and just had to wait while missing items etc.
reviews.author: Danielle E.

reviews.text: Nope. Try somewhere else. Chris the bar tender was skillful but very involved in washing glasses. Peter, the assistant, after water service was nonexistent. David our waiter was a great orator. He even explained the dish that was not available. To the food. The bread was terrific. The muscles were well prepared. The snapper was very nicely prepared, flavorful and nicely prepared. The crab dip was a bit over cooked and dry. I really enjoyed the brisket soup. Our table service was abysmally slow. Empty glasses decorated our table for ten to 15 minutes at a time. The pace was deliberate which would be enjoyable if our empty plates were removed and the drinks consistently refilled.  We were treated to a complementary desert for our anniversary. In summary, food 4 stars, atmosphere 5 stars, service 0 stars. Or "Come for the bread and stay for the soup" then leave.
reviews.author: David S.

reviews.text: Mowry & Cotton did not disappoint.  Starting with the beautiful view from our outside table.  Started with fresh kale juice which was good with a hint of ginger.  And yes, you could not tell it was kale.  My husband had a mixed green salad whch was fresh and delicious with tasty Toppings and a mild dressing.  I had the citrus plate offset by dates, pomegranates and pistachios.  A lovely, healthy starter.  My husband had the breakfast tacos with hanger steak and fried egg. He wished he would have skipped the egg as the steak had a wonderful flavor.  Next time egg on the side.  I had the crab avacado egg brushetta.   I loved it.  Scrammbled eggs cooked perfectly.  Had to take half home.  This is a great place for a special occasion.  Somewhat pricey for everyday.
reviews.author: Susan K.

reviews.text:
In the glossy pages of "So Scottsdale" magazine,  Mowry & Cotton looks like an upscale,  trendy,  and can't miss addition to the Scottsdale restaurant scene.  The reality of dining there however falls far short.  

The food is only average with too many better local choices to make.  The service too is just adequate.  Even with reservations you will wait for a table.  There is a sense of chaos that the place is just one dropped plate from being out of control.   From multiple unbussed tables,  to serving stands randomly collected,  and disorganized drink stands,  the place is just unbecoming a resort like the Phoenician.

The one redeeming quality is the setting.  The property is still beautiful,  even in the midst of major rennovation. Go for the views and not the food or service.  

With resort prices for moderly adequate food,  Mowry & Cotton will struggle when the tourists are gone as the locals aren't likely to frequent here.
reviews.author: Jeff W.

reviews.text: Mowry & Cotton is a restaurant located inside the newly renovated Phoenician Resort in Scottsdale AZ. I attended the yelp elite event there last week and had a great time. All staff received us very well, the appetizers, deserts and drinks were soooo good! See photos of meals & views. Definitely recommend this place! Thank you Yelp and Hailey P for the invite
reviews.author: Ana E.

reviews.text: This restaurant seems like it is trying way too hard to be some sort of trendy. We stayed at the phonecian and so ate at this restaurant multiple times purely out of convenience. The brunch had no items I actually wanted to order and when it was brought out was disappointing. Also, the eggs seemed fake and cold. For dinner we got the rolls, cod and salmon, all of which were just so so. I would not order again. It seems like they are trying very hard to be trendy and loosing focus of good food that people actually like to eat. For such a great hotel you would think they would have better dining options. That being said, the staff was great. Very friendly and knowledgeable, although I felt bad for them having to wear those outfits.
reviews.author: Kelly F.

reviews.text: Sounds like brunch is good here but dinner was not great!   I was excited because the Phoenix Times said the chef  was great.  Trying too hard.  We had a pheasant salad, bones in it and not good.  The cowboy steak was fatty. Go to steak house to get a great steak. Scallops were good.  Beets ok. Desert just ok.  Nothing was great!  Drinks, bread were good and service was good.  Started to get busy so not sure service would be great.  Very disappointed.
reviews.author: Kathy M.

reviews.text:
This restaurant has fabulous food and drinks.  The fish tacos were perfect!  The whole fish comes to the table and you make your own little tacos for communal dining.

This restaurant would definitely be worth a visit to even if you aren't staying at the Phoenician.  When you go to the restaurant, your parking will be validated.  The ambiance is amazing!
reviews.author: Lisa B.

reviews.text:
We are staying at the Phoenician for our stay here in Scottsdale and have been to this restaurant several times. 
I'd say it's best for breakfast. I recommend the avocado toast, eggs benedict, or the stuffed French toast if you're looking for something sweeter. 
They charge 4 dollars for a very small cup of orange juice, which in my opinion is a rip-off, because there are not refills. 
The dinner was pretty good, but not anything out of this world. They do not serve complimentary bread, you have to pay about $10 for it. If I recommend anything for dinner, I'd recommend the krispy potatoes (side item).
reviews.author: Elsa C.

reviews.text: Just had lunch here, have had two breakfast meals previously and first lunch experience was great.   Flatbreads yummy, ahi tuna sandwich on lettuce leafs fantastic,   Lamb Tacos tasty!   Chicken bowl over the top.   Fresh is the main theme here everything tastes so fresh.   Great cocktails as well!  I do not understand the average stars.  Service great.   Good alternative to your 3 meal a day typical resort restaurant.
reviews.author: Michelle B.

reviews.text: This place is horrible . Food is not cooked well. There was glass found in our drink and management did nothing about it. Phoenician needs to have a better restaurant then this place.
reviews.author: Vincent T.

reviews.text:
Mowry and Cotton with an interesting name and history behind the name of the restaurant.

Chef Tandy Peterson has assembled quite an awesome menu.

Our waiter Myron was very good and offered a indept explanation and recommendation of favorite dishes.

Lily the hostess almost ruined the entire evening. Of course I understand that a large portion of the seating is outside in the patio by the pool and what happens on Valentine's Dinner, it rains. So Lilly sits us at a table in the bar, I ask her if there are other options not in the bar, her reply is you can sit outside (in the rain and cold) or at the bar counter. So table in the bar it is. The table was by the entrance and hostess podium, so we see everyone who comes in and the next 8 couples get seated in the dining area within an hour. I almost blew my top, luckily my wife calmed me down or I would have confronted Lily the hostess. I was so pissed off!! Fortunately the food and Myron were incredible or I would have questioned Lily why everyone else was being seated in the dining room and we were not given that option. I made the reservations through Open Table about a month and a half ago for a special Valentine's Dinner with my wife.

Ordered the Cowboy Ribeye, the Grilled Black Cod, Crispy Potatoes and Apple Crumble

Cowboy Ribeye is prepared in smoked blue cheese, onions, pepita and chimicura. Cooked as requested medium rare. Looked like it Tomahawk Ribeye cut and very tender and delicious. 

The Grilled Black Cod is prepared with parsnip, spinach, wildflower honey, cashews and finger lime. Very very tender and soft fish, just melts in your mouth and an awesome sauce to choose if you want to dip it in it.  Very impressive

Crispy Potatoes with Chorizo, Horesradish, Tomato Brava Hot Sauce. Potatoes are very crispy exactly as advertised and the way I like potatoes. The mixture is just plain awesome.

To top it off, we ordered the Apple Crumble which is served with ice cream. The Apple Crumble is served with apple, caramel and molasses. The incredible part is the ice cream. When served, it looks like an apple, with the Apple Crumble, but it is ice cream shaped and painted to look like a peach and the stem is made of chocolate. WOW!

Towards the end of the dinner, we see Michael Bidwell, owner of the AZ Cardinals leaving from the dining room. So if the owner of the AZ Cardinals is having his Valentine's Dinner here then we must have made a good choice.

Besides Lily the hostess, this is an incredible restaurant based on the food and service.

I will give this truly a 4.5 Stars with the half deduction of the hostess, but overall a 5 star.
reviews.author: Dwayne O.

reviews.text: The food was amazing but the service doesn't deserve 1 star. I was referred to visit Mowry from my father who's in the medical field and very often has had recommendations for lunch. He has an exuberant amount of lunch meetings and I trusted his associates for advice although he had never been. During December I visited with a colleague who I wanted to refer to my workplace. I thought she would be a great asset to the company and could really help our property grow in numerous different ways. First, I will say we were the only young woman joining for lunch, and very few female servers were working that day. My server was an elderly hispanic man who took over 10 minutes to deliver a flat soda, that tasted similar to a watered down la croix. He very apparently was giving our table less service because of 1. age 2. gender and 3. lack of knowledge and assuming. In Scottsdale alone you should never ASSUME what your customer is making annually because you NEVER know who you're serving. I have never been the type of individual to yelp but my colleague and PC member really left a comment that resides with me and so, here I am. "Perception is everything", every guest sees how you deliver service to other tables. Never in my life have I given less than a 20% tip, why? Because we all start somewhere and I know others work under the servers alone to make money. Someone has to help the workers pay their way through college, beauty school, or just rent. I've been there, many of us have. But the lack of attention and care for our table of JUST TWO individuals was absolutely astonishing. All in all, DO NOT ASSUME ABOUT YOUR GUEST. It shows a lack of care, and proves that you are just working to make money. It is so much for than that. Truthfully, if you do not know how to be a service-oriented individual then quit.
reviews.author: Tiffany L.

reviews.text:
Great drinks, amazing food, and super fast service.

I came here with a group of about 18 on a Saturday night. They set us at a large table already put together on the patio. Everything who worked there was very friendly and helpful. Our drink order was taken and delivered quickly, as was the food. I was very impressed at the speed at which the kitchen put great food out.

As for my favorites - you definitely need to try the meatballs, chicken flatbread, old fashioned, crispy potatoes, and the ribeye.
reviews.author: Kirk M.

reviews.text: Really good experience! I wasn't sure if coming here was a good idea since this place has only 3.5 star average BUT I have it a try and I must say this is definitely a 4.5 or 5 star restaurant. My dinning experience was amazing!! Customer service was excellent and the ambience was relaxing  recommend this
reviews.author: Solanch B.

reviews.text: This place is a disgrace the service is beyond awful and the staff know it. It takes at least 20 minutes to get someone's attention upon seating. Prepare for long waits and zero attention to customer service.
reviews.author: Noora B.

reviews.text: Very expensive for what you get but the ambience is great and the Phoenician is beautiful. Our waiter was very attentive but the food was so-so. Spare ribs were dry and a little on the tough side, dungenous crab dip was fishy, and the cauliflower had a rich creamy sauce on it and is basically a head of cauliflower plopped on your table. We much preferred Il Terazzo, the restaurant that used to be in this space
reviews.author: Marisa L.

reviews.text: We stopped in shortly after they opened last year to check the place out and enjoy a cocktail on the patio overlooking the pool.  I enjoyed The Boss cocktail - sparkling wine with strawberry and thoroughly enjoyed it.  We'll definitely come back in for a meal and see what all the buzz is about with the food.
reviews.author: Jennifer S.

reviews.text: I want so badly to leave a great review, and the ambiance is beautiful! Unfortunately the service missed the mark. We were there for one hour, because the service was so slow that we left to go to another restaurant. Our server was nice and genuine, but it took over 20 minutes to get one cocktail. We were waiting for over 15 minutes trying to order, when our group just decided to go somewhere else. Sad, because it could have been circumstance or maybe our server was swamped.
reviews.author: Jenna G.

reviews.text:
First let's fix the lighting issue.... simple, just turn the dimmers DOwN! At least for dinner!! Way too bright if you sit inside. The patio seating, which is plentiful thank you, with heaters, thanks again, is a better choice. 
Next the furniture.... shameful for the PHONECIAN?!!! Feels like you're in a run of the mill coffee shop. Again a simple fix.

On to the food. Everything we had was tasty enough to order again! 

First the Mussels... big portion, plenty of sauce for dipping, w/ bits of chorizo... great!
Next the Whole roasted Seabass. Perfectly cooked w/ tantalizing flavors, great!
We also had the buttermilk buns with spreads and pickled veg. And with just this and a bottle of bubbly we were stuffed and had to leave with no dessert which we are totally going to have on our next visit.... maybe first!

We saw reviews on open table about poor service. Just ask for Sarah, knowledgeable about every detail on the menu, timing was perfect and she even brought a lap blanket for the wife 'cause it's kinda chilly in there too.... bring a sweater.

HEY MOWRY - fix the lighting and the furnishings issues and you'll be 5 stars!!!
reviews.author: S B.

reviews.text:
Amazing restaurant with impeccable food. The Chef Tandy Peterson works magic with the menu. 

The view of The Phoenician's swimming pool makes the setting that much more memorable. We went in the evening and the lighting was stunning. 

Don't miss if you are visiting Scottsdale or Phoenix.
reviews.author: Shoba S.

reviews.text: Tried it with a couple friends. Not quite sure what it wants to be. Tapas? Not really. Family style? Not so much. Food was hit and miss. Flatbread was great, pheasant was mediocre. Cocktail menu was okay, though a bit on the sweet side. Won't try it again.
reviews.author: Addison C.

reviews.text: A wonderful experience.  Great food and wonderful service.  The staff was extremely friendly all the way from valet service, hostess, and our waitress.  They had great vegetarian options - we had a couple in our party and they really enjoyed the food. Hand crafted pizzas were amazingly tasty.
reviews.author: Caprimash F.

reviews.text: Heard good things about this place finally got to come in for lunch and got one of their burgers was expecting much but I was pretty impressed really nice size Burger juicy at that love the condiments I think they're pickles Our House made which is really good Dario Lee was pretty good as well salad was okay who got the chips I also had their s'more pie which is really good could have been little hotter but Louie gooey goodness might just go back for that I said at the bar bartender was awesome explain different things on the menu you got to talking talking about different drinks they had four things are made made me feel at home make it was slow but definitely will go back again
reviews.author: Royce K.

reviews.text: We have been going to the Phoenician for Christmas buffet for several years. So very disappointed with their decision to no longer have this event. They offered a Christmas brunch this year with very average tasting food. The New York steak was served rare. We asked for it to be medium well and they returned it seared and still raw. The sea bass was over salted. Dessert was a bread pudding that was dried out. We won't be returning to the Mowry & Cotton ever again. Our waiter told us several people were expecting the same Christmas brunch as years before and like us were terribly disappointed.
reviews.author: Glenny C.

reviews.text: M&C has an interesting menu.  Most things we ordered were pretty good.  They serve everything family style, which we enjoyed.  The ambiance of the restutrant was great (we ate outside).  My issues were that the brisket soup was not edible due to an over abundance of salt.  I normally salt everything and can never remember something being too salty but this soup was not consumable.  We told the server and his response was, "yes, it is pretty salty".  he made no offer to replace it with something else NOR did he take it off our bill.  The server was nice enough but he clearly needed significant training and/or coaching.  I'm not sure if we'll go back.  I'm not sure I'd recommend it.  If you do go, PLEASE avoid the brisket soup.
reviews.author: derinda e.

reviews.text:
This is hands down the best brunch I've had in Arizona. First off, the staff is incredibly friendly and highly knowledgeable about each item on the menu. They make great recommendations based on your personal tastes and will follow up to make sure everything is as you expected. The brisket Benedict was OUT OF THIS WORLD, and that's coming from a true Benedict connoisseur. The pork plate was a wonderful variety of meat from a whole hog but the real star of this dish is the crumpets, they're truly delicious. The Brussel sprouts were cooked perfectly. The sorbet mimosas are the perfect way to cap the meal. I highly recommend the passion fruit!

Outside, they have a falconer who is very friendly and will show you his falcon and explain all the intricacies or taking care of such a majestic animal. 

Overall, I would highly recommend Mowry and Cotton to anybody passing through Phoenix!

reviews.text: They need to go back to the drawing board. For a great hotel the food and service is on par with Howard Johnson. I don't need to hear how much the staff lives the food and that it is the best food they have ever had.

reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant at the Phoenician! The food comes in generous portions that are great to share. Our server was able to help us with any questions we had and when the food arrived it did not disappoint. Bold flavors and so delicious I can't wait to go back.
reviews.author: Clayton V.

reviews.text:
We decided to give this restaurant a try to celebrate my fathers 88th birthday. We sat out on the magnificent terrace (with heaters) and had one of the most enjoyable dinning experiences in Scottsdale.
Where to begin? Our waiter Tyler was so pleasant and professional. He recommended a few dishes and we ended up trying 16 I'm total for 5 of us. The quality of the ingredients, the presentation and taste was faultless. We all found the dishes to be reasonably priced and each one was absolute heaven. We chose 5 vegetables and it's the first time in AZ that the Brussels have been cooked perfectly. Blanched and then grilled. The bison carpaccio is so delicate. The lamb tacos truly scrumptious. The bass was a true highlight. All is so fresh that it is hard to really have a winner! The chicken flatbread was my mother's preferred choice (she only eats chicken!!!)
Upon parking they asked the reason for the visit and one of the 5 desserts arrived with a personal birthday message. Wonderful touch to a truly magical evening. Thank you to everyone and especially the Chef who took the time to come out and meet us. I think she was truly impressed by the quantity of food we ordered. She's worked under Brinkley but I truly believe the food on offer tonight was far superior to her place of training.
reviews.author: Jane M.

reviews.text:
We celebrated my birthday dinner and had a wonderful experience from start to finish. Our server was passionate, fun and very informed about the food and their creative cocktails and we had so much fun talking about the menu.
We ended up choosing the semolina bread with crab dip (amazing!!!), roasted squash (served with whipped feta - OMG!), smoked spare ribs with a snap pea slaw and the whole striped bass to share. My son ordered the kids chicken and waffles which was super creatively served with waffle bites in a waffle cone, along with fries. The food came out perfectly, super flavorful, creative and we just loved everything we had. We will definitely be back to try other delicious menu choices. And soon!
reviews.author: Shelley F.

reviews.text:
I was in last night with friends for cocktails. M&C takes over the space formerly occupied by Il Terazzo on the ground level of the resort.  As you walk in the bar area is to the right and in front of you, dining room to the left and a big outdoor patio.

The service was friendly and the Western themed-vibe was explained to us.  We all ordered drinks from their cocktail list.  My Bourbon & Boujee was very good with bourbon, maple and brown sugar syrup, bitters and a piece of bacon for garnish.

The food menu looked pretty good but we didn't have anything to eat.

The biggest drawback was the design of the bar.  It was smallish and had a cold and unwelcoming feel to it.  Maybe a couple of area rugs under the two sitting areas inside by the windows, get rid of those gastly big light bulb lamps that my friend hit her head on and turn down the overhead lighting a little.
